nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks and Chipettes play in a dodgeball tournament in 'Munk Vs Machine', then in 'Shack Magic', The Chipmunks find a shack that magically fills with toys and games, but is it magic? (S4, ep 9)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Brittany dreams of being a fashion designer in 'The Devil Wears Rodentia', then in 'Career Day', Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously. (S3, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Jeanette and the Chipmunks rescue a chimpanzee in 'Chimpmania', then in 'Dad Jokes', Dave will be hosting an auction where he'll have to tell jokes, but will Alvin tell him he's not funny? (S4, ep 19)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin convinces Dave to give him his own room in 'A Room of One's Own', then in 'Carts and Crafts', Alvin inadvertently destroys Theodore's bicycle, so enters a contest to win a new bike. (S1, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin suspects his neighbour is responsible for a recent heist in 'What A Gem', and in 'Family Spirit', Alvin tries to get out of the family picnic with Dave to go to a soccer game. (S1, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore tries to overcome his fear of sleep-overs in 'Theo's Big Night Out', then in 'The Bodyguard', Alvin decides he needs a personal bodyguard, and trains Theodore for the job. (S3, ep 24)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin encourages Simon to write a frank email in 'Un-send!', then in 'The Orb', when Simon notices that Theodore has a hard time saying no, he creates the "No-Buddy". (S2, ep 12)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin accidentally clones himself in 'Double Trouble', then in 'Liar Liar', Alvin tells a small lie that quickly turns into a huge disaster, dragging everyone into his tangled web. (S2, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore is desperate to land the part of the monster in the school play in 'Clowning Around', then in 'Bully For You', Simon builds a homemade robot bodyguard. (S1, ep 8)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: A new boy band tries to steal the spotlight in 'We're the Chipmunks', then in 'Save the Dance', the Principal gives Alvin & Derek an ultimatum - if they fight, the dance will be cancelled. (S2, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon agrees to do whatever crazy thing Alvin wants him to do in 'Simon Says', then in 'Sing Like A Canary', a cute singing bird replaces Alvin in the band after he makes too many demands. (S4, ep 5)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The boys accidently break Dave's new flat screen TV in 'The Fugitives', and in 'Sherlock Chipmunk', Jeanette and Eleanor act as Sherlock Holmes and Watson when Theodore's teddy disappears. (S3, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin agrees not to speak for 24 hours in 'Spoiler-Itis', then in 'Something's Fishy', when Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they try to replace it before he notices. (S3, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Principal's cat goes missing in 'The Music Box', then in 'Special Delivery', Theodore's been mistakenly mailed off in a box, so Simon and Alvin have to get him home. (S2, ep 13)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin and Brittany face a spooky mystery in 'School Alone', then in 'It Came From Outer Space', Alvin's fake meteor causes chaos. (S3, ep 13)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore helps Simon to try and get past his perfectionism in 'Artsy Smartsy', then in 'The Crush', Simon has a crush on the babysitter and secretly prepares a romantic dinner. (S4, ep 13)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Breathless
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A French coed (Valérie Kaprisky) flees with a West Coast car thief (Richard Gere) who lives by comic books and Jerry Lee Lewis music.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Stigmata
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: An atheist's (Patricia Arquette) visions and manifestations of wounds like those of the crucified Christ prompt the Vatican to send an investigator (Gabriel Byrne).

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Mimic
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Married scientists (Mira Sorvino, Jeremy Northam) battle killer cockroaches that develop the ability to assume human form.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: mother!
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A woman's tranquil existence gets upended when her husband invites a man, his wife and their two children as guests in their Victorian mansion. Terror soon strikes when she tries to figure out why her husband is so accommodating to everyone but her.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Eye of the Needle
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A Nazi spy (Donald Sutherland) seduces the wife (Kate Nelligan) of a crippled pilot (Christopher Cazenove) on the Scottish coast before D-Day.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: To Live and Die in L.A.
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A Secret Service agent (William L. Petersen) bends and breaks the law to nab an artist/counterfeiter (Willem Dafoe) in Los Angeles.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Ronin
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: An Irish ringleader (Natascha McElhone) organizes an international team of hired guns (Robert De Niro, Jean Reno) to retrieve a briefcase from criminals.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: In the Line of Fire
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: An assassin toys with a White House Secret Service agent haunted for 30 years by his failure in 1963 Dallas.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Package
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: An Army sergeant (Gene Hackman) and his officer ex-wife (Joanna Cassidy) are caught in a Cold War plot over a military prisoner (Tommy Lee Jones).

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: To Live and Die in L.A.
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A Secret Service agent (William L. Petersen) bends and breaks the law to nab an artist/counterfeiter (Willem Dafoe) in Los Angeles.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: 52 Pick-Up
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: An affair with an exotic dancer and subsequent blackmail demands threaten the marriage of a businessman and his wife.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Sunset Boulevard
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Hack screenwriter Joe Gillis moves in with Hollywood has-been Norma Desmond and her devoted chauffeur, Max Von Mayerling.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Breakdown
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A man's (Kurt Russell) wife (Kathleen Quinlan) disappears in the desert Southwest after accepting a trucker's (J.T. Walsh) help with car trouble.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: In the Line of Fire
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: An assassin toys with a White House Secret Service agent haunted for 30 years by his failure in 1963 Dallas.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Ronin
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: An Irish ringleader (Natascha McElhone) organizes an international team of hired guns (Robert De Niro, Jean Reno) to retrieve a briefcase from criminals.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Package
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: An Army sergeant (Gene Hackman) and his officer ex-wife (Joanna Cassidy) are caught in a Cold War plot over a military prisoner (Tommy Lee Jones).

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Zodiac
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Investigators and reporters become obsessed with finding the serial killer terrorizing San Francisco in the late 1960s and '70s.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: The mastermind (Steve McQueen) of a Boston bank caper falls in love with the insurance sleuth (Faye Dunaway) on his trail.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A billionaire (Pierce Brosnan) looking for new challenges attracts the attention of an investigator (Rene Russo) when a priceless Monet is stolen.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Fatal Attraction
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A New York lawyer (Michael Douglas) with a wife (Anne Archer) and daughter sleeps with a client (Glenn Close) whose lust turns to hate.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Body of Evidence
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A lawyer (Willem Dafoe) defends a gold digger (Madonna) for murder by sex, a charge whose validity he soon sees for himself.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: The mastermind (Steve McQueen) of a Boston bank caper falls in love with the insurance sleuth (Faye Dunaway) on his trail.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Leaving Las Vegas
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Intent on drinking himself to death, a man (Nicolas Cage) who has lost everything finds solace with a Las Vegas hooker (Elisabeth Shue).

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Lenny
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: 1950s comic Lenny Bruce (Dustin Hoffman) spurs controversy with his drug use, graphic language and marriage to a stripper (Valerie Perrine).

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Hellraiser III: Hell on Earth
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A New York TV newswoman (Terry Farrell) battles Pinhead (Doug Bradley) and the Cenobites with a World War I captain's ghost.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Hellraiser IV - Bloodline
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A man (Bruce Ramsay) in a space station battles evil Pinhead (Doug Bradley), as did his ancestors in 18th-century France and in 1996.

mgmplushits.us.title: Lady Jane
mgmplushits.us.description: King Henry VIII has died, and his only heir, a young Edward VI (Warren Saire), is dying too. Minister John Dudley (John Wood) doesn't want the Roman Catholic Princess Mary (Jane Lapotaire) to become queen, as that would end the Protestant Reformation. Dudley plots to keep Edward alive long enough to name Lady Jane Grey (Helena Bonham Carter) as his heir and also marries Jane to his son, Guilford (Cary Elwes). Jane and Guilford soon fall in love, but the kingdom doesn't believe they should rule. (Historical drama) - 1986

mgmplushits.us.title: An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power
mgmplushits.us.description: Former Vice President Al Gore continues his tireless fight, traveling around the world to train an army of activists and influence international climate policy. Cameras follow him behind the scenes -- in moments both private and public, funny and poignant -- as he pursues the inspirational idea that while the stakes have never been higher, the perils of climate change can be overcome with human ingenuity and passion. (Documentary) - 2017

mgmplushits.us.title: Chaplin
mgmplushits.us.description: Re-creation of the life of comic genius Charles Chaplin, from his humble beginnings in south London through his early days in British vaudeville, his silent movie career in America and his late masterpieces. His turbulent personal life saw four marriages and an enforced exile from the US - though he returned to receive an honorary Oscar in 1972. (Biography) - 1992

mgmplushits.us.title: Imagine That
mgmplushits.us.description: Like many busy professionals, Evan Danielson (Eddie Murphy) is so focused on his career that quality time with his young daughter, Olivia (Yara Shahidi), has fallen by the wayside. When an important promotion is suddenly within reach, stressed-out Evan starts to fall apart while trying to fend off his company rival (Thomas Haden Church). But when little Olivia introduces him to the inhabitants of her imaginary land, Evan rediscovers his inner child and finds the answers to all his problems. (Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Drama) - 2009

mgmplushits.us.title: North Dallas Forty
mgmplushits.us.description: A brutal satire of American professional football in which a veteran pass-catcher's individuality and refusal to become part of the team family is bitterly resented by his disciplinarian coaches. The National Football League refused to help in the production of this movie, suggesting it may have been too near the truth for comfort. From the novel by former NFL player Peter Gent. (Comedy drama) - 1979

mgmplushits.us.title: American Hostage - Tomorrow Is Here
mgmplushits.us.description: Having sold the lie of immunity on-air and successfully convinced Tony to sign the agreement, Fred now finds himself shut out of law enforcement's plans to bring this crisis to an end today, one way or another. (Crime, Thriller) - 2026-10-25

mgmplushits.us.title: Treasure Island - Chapter 3: The Wide Eternal Sea
mgmplushits.us.description: Alliances fracture as the voyage wears on; Bess and Graham play a cat-and-mouse game, while Long John targets Jim; when Graham makes his move, the truth surfaces; the consequences are deadly and Jim is forced to take control of his fate. (Adventure) - 2026-10-25

mgmplushits.us.title: The School of Rock
mgmplushits.us.description: Overly enthusiastic guitarist Dewey Finn (Jack Black) gets thrown out of his bar band and finds himself in desperate need of work. Posing as a substitute music teacher at an elite private elementary school, he exposes his students to the hard rock gods he idolizes and emulates -- much to the consternation of the uptight principal (Joan Cusack). As he gets his privileged and precocious charges in touch with their inner rock 'n' roll animals, he imagines redemption at a local Battle of the Bands. (Comedy, Music) - 2003

mgmplushits.us.title: Back to School
mgmplushits.us.description: Thornton Melon (Rodney Dangerfield) is concerned that his son Jason (Keith Gordon) is unsure whether to go to college, so the uneducated self-made millionaire encourages him by signing up as a student as well. As Jason tries to establish himself among his peers and make the diving team, Thornton falls for a pretty professor (Sally Kellerman) and gets others do his schoolwork for him. When the suspicious dean (Paxton Whitehead) finds out, Thornton needs to show he can get by on his own. (Comedy) - 1986

mgmplushits.us.title: The Passenger
mgmplushits.us.description: Randy is perfectly content to fade into the background, but when one of his co-workers goes on a sudden and violent rampage, he must face his fears and confront his troubled past to survive. (Thriller, Drama) - 2023

mgmplushits.us.title: Apache
mgmplushits.us.description: Adapted from the 1936 novel Bronco Apache, this groundbreaking Western casts a sympathetic eye on the struggles of Native Americans in the post-bellum West. Massai, the only Apache warrior still fighting after the surrender of Geronimo, is arrested and placed on a train headed for a Florida prison. After a daring escape, he begins the trip back home to his lover, Nalinle, on foot -- but the journey is long and treacherous, and the authorities are closing in. (Western) - 1954

mgmplushits.us.title: Hondo
mgmplushits.us.description: An embittered Indian scout attempts to escort a homesteader's wife and her son back to safety after her cowardly husband deserts her during an Apache attack. When she refuses to go, the scout stays on to help for a while and, over time, forms a strong bond with both her and her son. (Western, Drama, Romance, War) - 1953

mgmplushits.us.title: Sex Life - Dungeons and Unicorns
mgmplushits.us.description: Swinging by a lifestyle party; enjoying the intense burlesque of Michelle L'amour; looking behind the curtain at an L.A. dungeon. (Adults only, Erotic, Documentary) - 2019-07-12

mgmplushits.us.title: Smurfs
mgmplushits.us.description: When evil wizards Razamel and Gargamel take Papa Smurf, the Smurfs embark on a mission to the real world to save him. With help from some new friends, they must discover what defines their destiny to save the universe. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2025

mgmplushits.us.title: The Missouri Breaks
mgmplushits.us.description: When vigilante land baron David Braxton (John McLiam) hangs one of the best friends of cattle rustler Tom Logan (Jack Nicholson), Logan's gang decides to get even by purchasing a small farm next to Braxton's ranch. From there the rustlers begin stealing horses, using the farm as a front for their operation. Determined to stop the thefts at any cost, Braxton retains the services of eccentric sharpshooter Robert E. Lee Clayton (Marlon Brando), who begins ruthlessly taking down Logan's gang. (Western, Drama) - 1976

mgmplushits.us.title: The Great Gatsby
mgmplushits.us.description: Nick Carraway (Sam Waterston) is a young man from the Midwest living modestly among the decadent mansions of 1920s Long Island. He becomes involved in the life of the mysterious Jay Gatsby (Robert Redford), a rich man who throws the most lavish parties on the island. But behind Gatsby's outgoing demeanor is a lonely man who wants nothing more than to be with his old love, Daisy (Mia Farrow). She is married to the bullheaded Tom (Bruce Dern), creating a love triangle that will end in tragedy. (Drama) - 1974

mgmplushits.us.title: What's the Worst That Could Happen?
mgmplushits.us.description: Caffrey is a professional thief with taste and style who is trying to rob billionaire tycoon Max Fairbanks' unoccupied beachfront mansion. But in the middle of the robbery, he finds himself face to face with Fairbanks. As Caffrey is being arrested, Max sees a ring on Caffrey's finger and claims it for himself. It's Caffrey's engagement ring, and he's determined to get it back. (Comedy) - 2001

mgmplushits.us.title: Harley Davidson and the Marlboro Man
mgmplushits.us.description: In this action movie, tough biker Harley-Davidson (Mickey Rourke) teams up with his cowboy-hat-wearing buddy known as the Marlboro Man (Don Johnson) to help save the bar of a mutual friend. Enacting a plan to rob an armored bank vehicle, the two are surprised to find that they've heisted a massive shipment of a new drug. Soon the corrupt bank head, Chance Wilder (Tom Sizemore), sends trained killers to take out Harley and Marlboro, with the duo fighting for their lives. (Action) - 1991

mgmplushits.us.title: Beauty Shop
mgmplushits.us.description: Far from Chicago, hairdresser Gina Norris has relocated to Atlanta with her daughter and has quickly established herself as a rare talent in her profession. But after repeatedly butting heads with her shady, over-the-top boss, Jorge, Norris sets out to create her own salon -- even snagging a few of Jorge's employees and clients, including Lynn and Terri, respectively. Now, Jorge will do anything to shut her down. (Comedy) - 2005

mgmplushits.us.title: Mermaids
mgmplushits.us.description: Fifteen-year-old Charlotte Flax (Winona Ryder) is tired of her wacky mom (Cher) moving their family to a different town any time she feels it is necessary. When they move to a small Massachusetts town and Mrs. Flax begins dating a shopkeeper (Bob Hoskins), Charlotte and her 9-year-old sister, Kate (Christina Ricci), hope that they can finally settle down. But when Charlotte's attraction to an older man gets in the way, the family must learn to accept each other for who they truly are. (Comedy drama) - 1990

mgmplushits.us.title: The First Wives Club
mgmplushits.us.description: Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes. (Comedy) - 1996

mgmplushits.us.title: Book Club
mgmplushits.us.description: Four friends' lives are turned upside down when their book club tackles the infamous "50 Shades of Grey." From discovering new romance to rekindling old flames, they inspire each other to make their next chapter the best chapter. (Romantic comedy) - 2018

mgmplushits.us.title: Sabrina
mgmplushits.us.description: Sabrina Fairchild is a chauffeur's daughter who grew up with the wealthy Larrabee family. She always had unreciprocated feelings for David, the family's younger son and playboy. But after returning from Paris, Sabrina has become a glamorous woman who gets David's attention. His older, work-minded brother Linus thinks their courtship is bad for the family business and tries to break them up -- but then he starts to fall for her too. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 1995

mgmplushits.us.title: Kalifornia
mgmplushits.us.description: Brian Kessler (David Duchovny) is a writer, and his girlfriend, Carrie Laughlin (Michelle Forbes), is a photographer. They're working on a book about serial killers, and planning a trip across the country to document the sites of famous serial murders. To cut costs, they set up a ride-share with strangers, Early Grayce (Brad Pitt) and his girlfriend, Adele Corners (Juliette Lewis). But what they don't know is that Early is a violent sociopath in the middle of his own serial killing spree. (Thriller) - 1993

mgmplushits.us.title: Below
mgmplushits.us.description: The submarine U.S.S. Manta had a perfect record until the mysterious death of its captain. The next-in-command, Lt. Richard Brice (Bruce Greenwood) is determined to steer his disheartened crew back to safety. But after three battle survivors board the sub, bizarre and frightening things begin to happen. As the tale unfolds, and crew members begin to disappear, Ensign Douglas O'Dell (Matthew Davis) must piece together the puzzles of the submarine's past before it is too late to resurface alive. (Thriller) - 2002

mgmplushits.us.title: Good Boy!
mgmplushits.us.description: Thousands of years ago, dogs arrived on planet Earth from a faraway star with plans to take over the world. Now, the Greater Dane (Vanessa Redgrave) wants a report on the takeover, so she sends Hubble (Matthew Broderick) to investigate. When he's adopted by the lonely Owen (Liam Aiken), Hubble slowly realizes that dogs have forgotten their mission. They're not man's worst enemy -- they're his best friend. And, to make matters worse, the Greater Dane is headed to Earth for an inspection. (Comedy, Fantasy) - 2003

mgmplushits.us.title: Some Like It Hot
mgmplushits.us.description: After witnessing a Mafia murder, slick saxophone player Joe (Tony Curtis) and his long-suffering buddy, Jerry (Jack Lemmon), improvise a quick plan to escape from Chicago with their lives. Disguising themselves as women, they join an all-female jazz band and hop a train bound for sunny Florida. While Joe pretends to be a millionaire to win the band's sexy singer, Sugar (Marilyn Monroe), Jerry finds himself pursued by a real millionaire (Joe E. Brown) as things heat up and the mobsters close in. (Comedy) - 1959

mgmplushits.us.title: She Rides Shotgun
mgmplushits.us.description: Marked for death by unrelenting enemies, a newly released ex-con must protect his estranged 11-year-old daughter at all costs. With little resources and no one to trust, they form a bond under fire as they evade a corrupt sheriff and a brutal gang leader who'll stop at nothing to protect his criminal interests. (Action, Thriller) - 2025

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Project Hail Mary
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory slowly returns, he soon discovers he must solve the riddle behind a mysterious substance that's causing the sun to die out. As details of the mission unravel, he calls on his scientific training and sheer ingenuity -- but he may not have to do it alone. (Science fiction, Adventure) - 2026

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Running Man
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In the near future, "The Running Man" is the top-rated show on television, a deadly competition where contestants must survive 30 days while being hunted by professional assassins. Desperate for money to save his sick daughter, Ben Richards is convinced by the show's ruthless producer to enter the game as a last resort. Ratings soon skyrocket as Ben's defiance, instincts and grit turn him into an unexpected fan favorite, as well as a threat to the entire system. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2025

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Zodiac
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In the late 1960s and 1970s, fear grips the city of San Francisco as a serial killer called Zodiac stalks its residents. Investigators (Mark Ruffalo, Anthony Edwards) and reporters (Jake Gyllenhaal, Robert Downey Jr.) become obsessed with learning the killer's identity and bringing him to justice. Meanwhile, Zodiac claims victim after victim and taunts the authorities with cryptic messages, cyphers and menacing phone calls. (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2007

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Weekend in Taipei
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A former DEA agent and an ex-undercover operative rekindle their romance during a weekend in Taipei. As they reconnect, they're oblivious to the looming dangers stemming from their past operations. (Action, Thriller) - 2024

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Wildcat

screenpixaction.us.description: In the wake of a devastating earthquake, a former U.S. marshal (Jimmy Smits) fights thugs terrorizing an isolated Los Angeles community. (Thriller) - 1996

screenpixaction.us.title: Killing Streets
screenpixaction.us.description: When he's informed that his twin brother has died in Beirut, basketball coach Craig Brandt (Michael Paré) flies to Lebanon to investigate for himself. His brother was a U.S. Marine who, according to the military, died in an explosion during an anti-terrorist operation. At the U.S. Embassy, Craig meets with Charles Wolf (Lorenzo Lamas), who backs up the official story. Nevertheless, Craig has the uncanny feeling that his brother is still alive -- and that he's the only one who can save him. (Action) - 1991

screenpixaction.us.title: Halloween With The New Addams Family
screenpixaction.us.description: Burglars spend a hair-raising night among the bizarre guests at a weird clan's (John Astin, Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan) annual party. (Holiday, Musical comedy) - 1977

screenpixaction.us.title: The Comedy of Terrors
screenpixaction.us.description: Waldo Trumbull (Vincent Price) is an amoral undertaker in 19th-century New England who takes to murdering people to have enough cash to support his drinking habit. Desperate for money after a widow stiffs him for a burial, Trumbull and his assistant, Gillie (Peter Lorre), decide to kill the wealthy Mr. Black (Basil Rathbone), their landlord, to whom they're indebted. But murdering Black proves to be quite a challenge, as he seems to keep recovering from death every time they do him in. (Horror) - 1964

screenpixaction.us.title: Sleepaway Camp 2: Unhappy Campers
screenpixaction.us.description: Angela Baker (Pamela Springsteen), a psychotic transsexual, escapes from a mental hospital and surfaces at a summer camp as a counselor who lectures her teenage charges on proper moral behavior. Those teens who break her strict rules -- from the camp chatterbox or a sex-obsessed girl to the boys who are peeping Toms -- are murdered by the impostor in various gruesome ways. As more campers go missing, intrepid counselor Molly (Renee Estevez) begins to piece together the truth. (Horror) - 1988

screenpixaction.us.title: Sleepaway Camp 3: Teenage Wasteland
screenpixaction.us.description: Psychotic Angela (Pamela Springsteen) is itching to do what she does best: slaughter dozens of teenage campers. As luck would have it, the previous site of her murders has been renamed and converted into an experimental summer camp meant to bring together privileged and lower-class teens. On the day the youths are boarding the buses to camp, Angela runs over a potential camper with a garbage truck and assumes her identity. Once she has infiltrated the camp, the real terror begins. (Horror) - 1989

screenpixaction.us.title: Dr. Heckyl and Mr. Hype
screenpixaction.us.description: The kind but physically disfigured Dr. Heckyl is so distraught over his continual failures with the opposite sex that he decides to end his life by overdosing on an extra-strength diet drink. Strangely, he doesn't die -- he transforms into slick stud Mr. Hype. Unfortunately, Hype has an insatiable thirst for blood, and he ends up killing his dates before any romance unfolds. He soon sets his sights on the sweet Coral, who secretly loves Heckyl, but not Hype. (Horror) - 1980

screenpixaction.us.title: The Lost Empire
screenpixaction.us.description: Long-legged women warriors dress lightly on the island of evil Dr. Sin Do, also known as Li Chuk. (Science fiction) - 1984

screenpixaction.us.title: Vampires on Bikini Beach
screenpixaction.us.description: Californians (Jennifer Badham, Todd Kaufman) try to save their beach from a ghoul and his gang. (Horror) - 1988

screenpixaction.us.title: X: The Man With the X-Ray Eyes
screenpixaction.us.description: Intent on enhancing mankind's ocular ability, the brilliant Dr. James Xavier (Ray Milland) invents a formula that allows him to see wavelengths of light outside the normal human spectrum. When his funding is suddenly threatened, Xavier tests the formula on himself despite the protests of his colleague Dr. Diane Fairfax (Diana Van der Vlis). While the formula proves initially useful in a variety of minor tasks, Xavier soon finds himself able to see things that no man was meant to see. (Science fiction) - 1963

screenpixaction.us.title: Revenge of the Zombies
screenpixaction.us.description: Scott Warrington (Mauritz Hugo) returns to his childhood home in Louisiana after learning that his deceased sister, Lila (Veda Ann Borg), may have been poisoned. He brings a detective (Robert Lowery) with him, and they switch identities to protect Scott. At first, they find only Lila's sad husband, Dr. von Altermann (John Carradine). Secretly, however, von Altermann is a Nazi who has been perfecting a way to turn the dead, including Lila, into an army of zombies who will serve Hitler. (Horror) - 1943

screenpixaction.us.title: Fanfare for a Death Scene
screenpixaction.us.description: A federal agent (Richard Egan) tries to find a missing physicist who keeps a top-secret formula in his head. (Mystery) - 1964

screenpixaction.us.title: No Such Thing
screenpixaction.us.description: Disgusted with human evolution, a foul-mouthed monster kills anyone who crosses his path. When a news crew sent to investigate the monster disappears, a guileless young woman is dispatched to follow up on the story. She befriends the monster and becomes his only hope in ending his life of misery. (Fantasy, Comedy) - 2001

screenpixaction.us.title: Halloween With The New Addams Family
screenpixaction.us.description: Burglars spend a hair-raising night among the bizarre guests at a weird clan's (John Astin, Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan) annual party. (Holiday, Musical comedy) - 1977

screenpix.us.title: Dance With Me Henry
screenpix.us.description: Children help an amusement-park owner (Lou Costello) and his buddy (Bud Abbott) get out of trouble with gangsters. (Comedy) - 1956

screenpix.us.title: Sinful Davey
screenpix.us.description: Though his father received a death sentence for thievery, Davey Haggart (John Hurt) nevertheless wants to be a criminal too. He quits the military and starts carrying out small-time robberies. His pal Annie (Pamela Franklin) wants him to quit the criminal life, but she grudgingly helps him avoid law enforcement. Finally, though, Constable Richardson (Nigel Davenport) catches up with Davey, who will be hanged unless Annie and a fellow thief named MacNab (Ronald Fraser) can stop his execution. (Comedy) - 1968

screenpix.us.title: The Last Time I Saw Archie
screenpix.us.description: As World War II winds down, supply pilots at a stateside military base are left with few duties. Cocky Pvt. Archie Hall (Robert Mitchum) shirks even the most menial tasks by slyly leading everyone to believe he's a high-ranking officer working undercover. Alongside his buddy, Pvt. Bill Bowers (Jack Webb), Archie gets entangled with a pair of local women, Peggy (Martha Hyer) and Cindy (France Nuyen) -- one of whom might be passing secrets to the Japanese. (Comedy) - 1961

screenpix.us.title: Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush
screenpix.us.description: Frustrated that he still hasn't lost his virginity, teenage grocery store delivery boy Jamie McGregor (Barry Evans) appeals to Spike (Christopher Timothy), an older ladies' man, for advice. After failing to seal the deal with several local girls because of his working class mannerisms and a paralyzing case of teenage self-doubt, Jamie struggles to get the attention of Mary Gloucester (Judy Geeson), a beautiful classmate who doesn't seem to know he even exists. (Comedy) - 1968

screenpix.us.title: Clambake
screenpix.us.description: A wealthy young man, Scott Heyward (Elvis Presley) wants to experience life outside his privileged upbringing. When he meets Tom Wilson (Will Hutchins), an earnest water-skiing instructor, Scott offers to trade places with him. As Tom warms up to the good life, Scott gets used to a less luxurious existence and falls for Dianne Carter (Shelley Fabares), who, ironically, is hoping to meet a rich man. Sticking to his humble guise, Scott tries to woo Dianne without the benefit of his true status. (Musical) - 1967

screenpix.us.title: Allotment Wives
screenpix.us.description: An Army officer investigates a bigamy racket in which scheming women marry soldiers to collect their government checks. (Drama) - 1945

screenpix.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
screenpix.us.description: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1994

screenpix.us.title: Jacqueline
screenpix.us.description: A Belfast laborer (John Gregson) loses his job and drinks, but his daughter (Jacqueline Ryan) saves the day. (Drama) - 1956

screenpix.us.title: I Want to Live!
screenpix.us.description: This film tells the riveting true story of brazen bad girl Barbara Graham (Susan Hayward, in an Academy Award-winning performance), a perpetual offender who tries to go straight but is sent to death row after being implicated in a murder. When journalist Ed Montgomery (Simon Oakland), whose initial newspaper articles on Barbara's crime played up her recklessness, becomes convinced that she may be innocent, he begins a desperate campaign to save her from the gas chamber. (Biography) - 1958

screenpix.us.title: An Infinite Tenderness
screenpix.us.description: Two physically impaired children form a close connection to each other. (Drama, Docudrama) - 1969

screenpix.us.title: The Fugitive Kind
screenpix.us.description: When drifter Valentine Xavier (Marlon Brando) arrives in a southern town, he catches the eye of the married Lady Torrance (Anna Magnani) and the oversexed alcoholic, Carol Cutrere (Joanne Woodward). Both vie for his attention, with Lady Torrance emerging victorious, offering Xavier employment in her general store, while her cancer-stricken husband is bedridden upstairs. After impregnating Lady Torrance and butting heads with friends of her husband, Xavier must make a crucial decision. (Drama) - 1960

screenpix.us.title: The World of Henry Orient
screenpix.us.description: While trying to seduce a married woman (Paula Prentiss), egotistical concert pianist Henry Orient (Peter Sellers) is interrupted by two precocious schoolgirls, Valerie (Tippy Walker) and Marian (Merrie Spaeth). At first, he thinks nothing of it, but as he sees them more often, he becomes convinced they're spies for his lover's husband. The girls, meanwhile, have found out who he is, and Valerie insists she's in love. She starts a scrapbook, which her mother finds and, of course, misconstrues. (Comedy) - 1964

screenpix.us.title: Taras Bulba
screenpix.us.description: The tale of a Cossack chief who has sworn to be the eternal enemy of the treacherous Poles. So, when his son falls for a beautiful Pole who has saved his life, the father is faced with the dilemma of whether to kill his own flesh and blood as a traitor. This film reinforced the Brynner stereotype as king of the Asiatic wide open spaces. (Action) - 1962

screenpix.us.title: Allotment Wives
screenpix.us.description: An Army officer investigates a bigamy racket in which scheming women marry soldiers to collect their government checks. (Drama) - 1945

screenpix.us.description: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1994

screenpix.us.description: A Belfast laborer (John Gregson) loses his job and drinks, but his daughter (Jacqueline Ryan) saves the day. (Drama) - 1956

screenpix.us.title: Die, Monster, Die!
screenpix.us.description: Scientist Stephen Reinhart travels to a small town where he plans to visit his fiancée Susan Witley and meet her parents. Oddly, when he arrives, the townspeople are unfriendly. At Susan's parents' estate, her father, Nahum, is acting suspiciously and her mother, Letitia, is hidden away in a bedroom. When Stephen and Susan begin investigating the strange behavior in town, they realize that a radioactive meteor is to blame. (Horror, Mystery, Science fiction) - 1965

screenpix.us.title: The Oblong Box
screenpix.us.description: Julian (Vincent Price) hides his horrendously disfigured brother, Sir Edward Markham (Alister Williamson), in a tower where he is kept in chains. Anxious for freedom, Edward fakes his death with the aid of an immoral attorney, Trench (Peter Arne), and a pill that puts him into a catatonic state. But the escape plan takes a treacherous turn when Julian unwittingly buries his brother alive -- and he's later unearthed by grave robbers under the employ of malevolent Dr. Neuhardt (Christopher Lee). (Horror) - 1969

screenpix.us.title: Diary of a Madman
screenpix.us.description: When Judge Simon Cordier (Vincent Price) goes to see Louis Girot (Harvey Stephens), a prisoner he sentenced to death, the criminal insists he is not guilty and that he is inhabited by an evil spirit. Cordier dismisses Girot's claims, but he becomes unnerved when Girot lights himself on fire to supposedly end the demonic possession. After the visit, Cordier, beset by insomnia, begins to have odd visions and starts to wonder if Girot might have been telling the truth after all. (Horror) - 1963

screenpix.us.title: The Gravedancers
screenpix.us.description: After a funeral, several college friends reunite in a cemetery and reminisce about the former life of the deceased. The celebration starts to go too far after they get drunk and begin dancing on graves, and as a result, each of them becomes haunted by malevolent spirits. (Horror, Thriller) - 2006

screenpix.us.title: The Black Sleep
screenpix.us.description: Victorian Sir Joel (Basil Rathbone) prepares for his wife's brain surgery by practicing on locals supplied by a Gypsy (Akim Tamiroff). (Horror, Science fiction) - 1956

screenpix.us.title: The Ghost of Sierra de Cobre
screenpix.us.description: Vivia Mandore, an heiress, enlists the services of a paranormal investigator to look into a suspected case of haunting involving the spirit of her deceased mother-in-law. (Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 1964

screenpix.us.title: The Tiger's Tail
screenpix.us.description: Liam O'Leary (Brendan Gleeson) is a prosperous real estate tycoon who lives in Dublin with his wife, Jane (Kim Cattrall). Hoping to bring his profits and his career to new heights, Liam takes out a large bank loan with the prospect of building a new stadium. But, when his request for development is turned down by the city, his life stumbles into a downward spiral. More disturbing than his crippled assets is his mysterious double whom he keeps seeing around town. (Drama) - 2006

screenpix.us.title: Romance and Cigarettes
screenpix.us.description: In this musical that features characters lip-synching to classic songs, Nick (James Gandolfini), a Queens, N.Y.-based ironworker, lives with his wife, Kitty (Susan Sarandon), and three daughters. When Nick meets a significantly younger woman, Tula (Kate Winslet), he starts an affair with her, much to the chagrin of his wife, and his life is thrown into upheaval. Kitty kicks Nick out of the house, and he is forced to make some difficult decisions. (Musical comedy) - 2005

screenpix.us.title: Topkapi
screenpix.us.description: Beautiful thief Elizabeth Lipp (Melina Mercouri) and criminal genius Walter Harper (Maximilian Schell) put together a plan to steal an emerald-encrusted dagger from Istanbul's Topkapi Palace. As part of their crew, they hire small-time hustler Arthur Simon Simpson (Peter Ustinov) to act as their fall guy. When the Turkish secret police capture Simpson at the border, they persuade him to spy on his partners in crime, mistakenly believing that they're Communist agents plotting an assassination. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1964

screenpix.us.title: Die, Monster, Die!
screenpix.us.description: Scientist Stephen Reinhart travels to a small town where he plans to visit his fiancée Susan Witley and meet her parents. Oddly, when he arrives, the townspeople are unfriendly. At Susan's parents' estate, her father, Nahum, is acting suspiciously and her mother, Letitia, is hidden away in a bedroom. When Stephen and Susan begin investigating the strange behavior in town, they realize that a radioactive meteor is to blame. (Horror, Mystery, Science fiction) - 1965

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hell up in Harlem
screenpixvoices.us.description: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world. (Crime drama) - 1973

screenpixvoices.us.title: Diary of a Hitman
screenpixvoices.us.description: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task. (Crime drama) - 1992

screenpixvoices.us.title: Soda Cracker
screenpixvoices.us.description: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner. (Crime drama) - 1989

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Organization
screenpixvoices.us.description: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

screenpixvoices.us.title: Pressure Point
screenpixvoices.us.description: Frustrated by his inability to help an African-American patient who hates whites, a psychiatrist (Peter Falk) asks his superior (Sidney Poitier) to release him from the case. The superior relates a case from his own past during World War II when he treated a young Nazi (Bobby Darin) who despised blacks. Explaining the tragic results of the case, the older psychiatrist encourages his younger colleague not to be swayed by the patient's attitude, to remain objective and to stick with his treatment. (Drama) - 1962

As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world. (Crime drama) - 1973

screenpixvoices.us.title: Getting Even
screenpixvoices.us.description: Rival Texas chemical magnates (Edward Albert, Joe Don Baker) hold Dallas hostage over nerve gas stolen from the Soviets. (Thriller) - 1986

screenpixvoices.us.title: Mercenary Fighters
screenpixvoices.us.description: An emerging African nation pits soldiers of fortune (Peter Fonda, Reb Brown, Ron O'Neal) against rebels blocking a dam project. (Action) - 1988

screenpixvoices.us.title: Windprints
screenpixvoices.us.description: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. In a country ruled by a minority white government, Nhadiep seems only to murder other blacks. His proximity to the strange and horrifying crimes causes Anton to contemplate his role as a privileged white man in a continent where millions of blacks are oppressed. (Drama) - 1990

screenpixvoices.us.title: Mandela
screenpixvoices.us.description: This documentary follows the beloved South African leader Nelson Mandela from his early days to his presidency, depicting South Africa and its turbulent years during apartheid control, which was brought to an end in 1994 with the nation's democratic election of Mandela as president. Focus is placed on Mandela's early education, his personal relationships, and his political activism for the African National Congress, which led to his 27-year imprisonment for sabotage. (Documentary) - 1996

screenpixvoices.us.title: For Us, the Living
screenpixvoices.us.description: During the civil rights movement of the '50s and '60s in Mississippi, Medgar Evers (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) rose from being an insurance agent to become one of the most integral activists of the era. From boycotting white merchants in the mid '50s to being a key figure in desegregating the University of Mississippi in 1962, Evers met success, and with it many enemies. When racists swarm his house, his life and the lives of his wife (Irene Cara) and children are threatened. (Biography) - 1983

screenpixvoices.us.title: Blacula
screenpixvoices.us.description: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail. (Horror) - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Scream Blacula Scream
screenpixvoices.us.description: When a hated rival, Lisa Fortier (Pam Grier), is chosen to lead the voodoo cult of Willis Daniels' (Richard Lawson) late mother, a vengeful Willis brings the doomed vampire Prince Mamuwalde (William Marshall) back to life. Willis soon finds the vampire too powerful to control, and Lisa agrees to perform a spell that will break the curse placed on the prince. But, when racist sheriff Dunlop (Michael Conrad) gets involved, the vampire unleashes his deadly revenge. (Horror) - 1973

screenpixvoices.us.title: J.D.'s Revenge
screenpixvoices.us.description: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elijah Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago. (Horror) - 1976

screenpixvoices.us.title: Sugar Hill
screenpixvoices.us.description: When nightclub owner Langston (Larry D. Johnson) refuses to sell out to local mob boss Morgan (Robert Quarry), he is beaten to death by a gang of hired thugs. His grief-stricken fiancée, Diana "Sugar" Hill (Marki Bey), vows revenge for his murder and turns to aged voodoo authority Mama Maitresse (Zara Cully). Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers. (Horror) - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: The First Power
screenpixvoices.us.description: A Los Angeles policeman (Lou Diamond Phillips) hunts a killer (Jeff Kober) brought back from the gas chamber by Satan. (Horror) - 1990

Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers. (Horror) - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: The First Power
screenpixvoices.us.description: A Los Angeles policeman (Lou Diamond Phillips) hunts a killer (Jeff Kober) brought back from the gas chamber by Satan. (Horror) - 1990

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Belle of the Yukon
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A con man who has tried to turn over a new leaf, Honest John Calhoun (Randolph Scott) is the owner and operator of a dance hall in the north of Canada. John has hoped to evade both the police and his past, but his history catches up with him when his ex-girlfriend, Belle De Valle (Gypsy Rose Lee), appears in his venue as a member of a dance troupe. As John and Belle reunite, fellow entertainer Lettie Candless (Dinah Shore) also becomes infatuated with the suave businessman. (Musical) - 1944

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Another Man, Another Chance
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When Jeanne (Geneviève Bujold), a young woman, falls for a photographer named Francis (Francis Huster), he convinces her to leave war-torn France and move to America with him. After they have set up a photography shop and have a baby, Francis dies. A few years later, Jeanne meets David (James Caan), a solitary man who cannot forget the murder of his wife. Jeanne and David start a relationship, but she worries that his dangerous search for his wife's killers threatens their love. (Romance) - 1977

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Revolt at Fort Laramie
screenpixwesterns.us.description: At the dawn of the American Civil War, tensions begin to mount between Northern and Southern sympathizers stationed at Fort Laramie in Wyoming. The Southern soldiers, led by Maj. Seth Bradner (John Dehner), leave Fort Laramie to join the Confederate cause. But when Bradner is captured by a fortune-seeking Sioux tribe en route to Texas, it's up to Capt. James Tenslip (Gregg Palmer), a Northerner who has fallen for Bradner's niece Melissa (Frances Helm), to save him. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Gun Brothers
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Traveling to what he thinks is his brother's cattle ranch, Chad Santee (Buster Crabbe) meets pretty Rose Fargo (Ann Robinson) when he saves her from the clutches of bad guy Blackjack (James Seay). Together, the two visit Chad's brother, Jubal (Neville Brand), only to learn that he is actually a cattle rustler. They convince him to go straight, antagonizing his partner, Shawnee Jack (Michael Ansara), who feels so betrayed that he comes after all three of them with guns blazing. (Western) - 1956

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians
screenpixwesterns.us.description: By 1885, beloved cavalryman Buffalo Bill Cody (Paul Newman) has hired a publicist and producer to help shape and promote his traveling Wild West show, which presents historically inaccurate reenactments of conflicts between U.S. troops and Native Americans. Cody hires Chief Sitting Bull (Frank Kaquitts) to play himself, as a villain, in stagings of the Battle of the Little Bighorn. But, to Cody's dismay, star performer Annie Oakley (Geraldine Chaplin) and spectators both take to Sitting Bull. (Comedy, Drama, Western) - 1976

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Meeting at Mimbres
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The U.S. Army recruits Bat after several enraged Indian tribes accuse white men of abducting their women and children; Bat must find the culprits before a war breaks out. (Western) - 1961-04-13

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Valley of Death
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Major Whitsett's plans to run for office in Colorado Territory prompt his colonel to send him into an Indian ambush. (Western) - 1961-04-20

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Marked for Murder
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hollister spots a known criminal whose sidekick is sure to be joining him, and tries to lay a trap for the slippery crooks. (Western) - 1959-03-20

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Payroll to Tombstone
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hollister investigates when thousands of dollars of payroll money is stolen, but the Army suspects the courier made off with the cash. (Western, Action) - 1959-03-27

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Sitting Bull
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Recognizing that Maj. Robert Parrish (Dale Robertson) has a history of making peace with Native American tribes, President Ulysses S. Grant (John Hamilton) sends him to iron out a land dispute with Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish). Though negotiations seem to be going well, Parrish can't stop the deadly Battle of Little Big Horn. Many die, but when he helps Sitting Bull survive, Parrish is charged with crimes against the government, and he will be executed unless Grant steps in. (Western) - 1954

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Southwest Passage
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Edward Beale (Rod Cameron) and his caravan are en route to California as part of the U.S. Cavalry's initiative to utilize camels as cargo carriers for desert treks. Beale and his men join up with an escaped bank robber, Clint McDonald (John Ireland), who is impersonating a doctor. When one of Beale's men discovers McDonald's fraud, he blackmails the thief for a share of the bank loot. But then a far more menacing threat emerges in the form of American Indian warriors. (Western) - 1954

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Utah Kid
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A lawman and a rodeo rider go after a gang that's been bribing and doping rodeo contestants to affect the outcome and make a bundle of cash. (Western) - 1944

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Fort Defiance
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After the Civil War, veteran Ben Shelby (Ben Johnson) travels to Arizona to seek out fellow veteran Johnny Tallon (Dane Clark). After saving Johnny's blind brother, Ned (Peter Graves), from being trampled by a horse, Ben accompanies him to the family ranch. While Ben and Ned become friends, Ned's uncle grows suspicious about Ben's claim of friendship with Johnny. As they all wait for news of Johnny, they face an Indian attack and the arrival of vengeful former soldiers also seeking Johnny. (Western) - 1951

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Mercenary
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Sergei Kowalski, a mercenary only out for himself and a few dollars, joins up with a Mexican peasant-turned-revolutionary, Paco Roman, when the price is right. No longer content to toil for the rich and powerful, Roman plans to bring a new order to Mexico by force with his small ragtag group. While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly, a vengeful killer out for blood. (Western) - 1968

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Dalton Girls
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After the criminal Dalton brothers are slain, two of the brothers' eldest daughters, Holly and Rose, get into an altercation with an undertaker and are forced to kill him. On the run from Detective Hiram Parsh, who pursued the Dalton brothers for years, Holly and Rose take assumed names and begin a life of petty crime in order to get money to send their younger sisters, Columbine and Marigold, to school in the East. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Broken Star
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Deputy Marshal Frank Smeed (Howard Duff) guns down an innocent Mexican who was about to deliver a huge sum of gold to a land tycoon, then makes off with the loot and covers his tracks by claiming that the man he shot was a dangerous criminal. Deputy Marshal Bill Gantry (Bill Williams) is charged with investigating the matter to ensure that his close friend Smeed was in the right. When he gets too close to discovering the truth, the crooked deputy tries to make Gantry his next victim. (Western) - 1956

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Brass Legend
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Sheriff Wade Addams is engaged to Linda Gipson and searching for an elusive killer, Tris Hatten. Linda's little brother, Clay, happens upon Tris' hideout one day, and immediately notifies Wade, who arrests the killer. Despite efforts to keep Clay's involvement a secret, the details come out and Clay's life is threatened. Wade must protect Clay while sidestepping attempts on his own life by Tris' henchmen. (Western) - 1956

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Gunslinger
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When her marshal husband is murdered, Rose Hood (Beverly Garland) slides on his holster and takes his dangerous duty. This riles local brothel madam Erica Page (Allison Hayes), so she employs Cane Miro (John Ireland), a hired gun with an axe to grind, to bring an end to Hood and her brand of justice. When Miro meets Hood, though, he is struck by her strength and beauty. Still, the passion that begins to burn between them will not prevent their inevitable showdown. (Western) - 1956

screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat seeks justice for a young friend murdered by three ranchers whom the young man accused of cheating at cards, but the sheriff refuses to take action against the killers. (Western) - 1961-04-27

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Dead Man's Claim
screenpixwesterns.us.description: While returning to explore an old silver claim in Monument City, Nev., Bat runs afoul of two claim jumpers with itchy trigger fingers. (Western) - 1961-05-04

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Day of the Amnesty
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hired killers have the run of the town after the end of a bloody range war ends, but one rancher whose son was killed wants revenge, regardless of the general amnesty. (Western) - 1959-04-03

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Trail's End
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hollister tracks a man who murdered a miner and stole the man's gold. (Western, Action) - 1959-04-10

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Cannon for Cordoba
screenpixwesterns.us.description: During the 1912 Mexican Revolution, rebel leader Hector Córdoba (Raf Vallone) and his bloodthirsty revolutionaries slip across the Texas border and liberate a number of cannons from a U.S. Army fort. Under direct orders from General Pershing (John Russell), Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) heads into Mexican territory to face down Córdoba and get back the American cannons with the help of Mexican military officer Antonio (Gabriele Tinti) and alluring local Leonora (Giovanna Ralli). (Western, Action, Romance) - 1970

screenpixwesterns.us.title: God Forgives, I Don't
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Psychotic bandit Bill San Antonio kills all the passengers on a train and steals a fortune in gold. Hutch Bessy, an insurance investigator, and his gunslinger partner, Cat Stevens, go on the hunt for Bill, hoping to retrieve the loot. Unfortunately, outlaws take Hutch and Cat prisoner. Cat manages to get away and saves Hutch's life. When Cat is kidnapped later by other crooks, Hutch has to reciprocate. But they still have Bill to worry about. (Western, Action) - 1967

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Comanche
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Renegade Comanche leader Black Cloud (Henry Brandon) attacks a Mexican village and kidnaps the beautiful Margarita Alvarez (Linda Cristal). Fleeing to the United States, they come across a band of scalp hunters and are prevented from massacring them by the Comanche chief of the Antelope tribe, Quanah (Kent Smith). Despite the efforts of frontier scout Jim Read (Dana Andrews), turmoil erupts between the whites and the rebel Comanche, and Quanah and Read struggle to restore peace. (Western) - 1956

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Whiskey and Ghosts
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Davy Crockett's ghost appears and wanders around what looks like the West. (Fantasy) - 1976

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Alamo: Thirteen Days to Glory
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In 1836, Jim Bowie, Davy Crockett and the Texas rebels make a heroic last stand at the Alamo against the Mexican army of several thousand men led by General Santa Anna. (Western, Action, Adventure, Drama) - 1987

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Sonora Stagecoach
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The Trail Blazers (Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele, Chief Thundercloud) escort an innocent man to a fair trial. (Western) - 1944

nick.uk.title: Rock Paper Scissors - The Holiday Picture; Scrubs
nick.uk.description: Rock, Paper and Scissors want to take the perfect photo for their Christmas card but run into a problem; Paper and Scissors get into trouble by pretending to be someone else.

nick.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Plankton's Squeeze Play; How the West Was Dumb
nick.uk.description: To get closer to the secret formula, Plankton swaps bodies with Squidward and must learn to adapt to his new lanky form. Sandy teaches SpongeBob cowboy skills while they pan for bubbles, unaware that Krabs trails them in the hunt.

nick.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Laundro-Madness; Hog Huntin
nick.uk.description: Squidward spends a day at the laundromat with his fellow Bikini Bottomites. SpongeBob and Patrick must track down Old Man Jenkins' prized worm hog.

nick.uk.title: The Loud House - Gags to Riches; Sole Searching
nick.uk.description: After Luan pranks Grouse with a fake lottery ticket, she has to deal with the consequences of his massive shopping spree. Lynn desperately searches for a popular brand of basketball shoes after she narrowly misses out on buying a pair.

nick.uk.title: Wylde Pak - Date Night; Behind the Jingle
nick.uk.description: Will and Min's date ends up in a rideshare turf war; at home, Halmoni throws a party as the kids try to prove they can watch themselves; the family gets famous after the Groom and Board Jingle hits number one, but fame is fickle and tears them apart.

nick.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show - Scary Tales
nick.uk.description: Hans reads the Stars haunted fairy tales.

nick.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Duct Tape Dystopia; Farmers Market Feud
nick.uk.description: Mr. Krabs repairs issues around the Krusty Krab with duct tape; soon, however, the quick fixes lead to one big headache.

nick.uk.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business - Mega Fat
nick.uk.description: A flashback reveals everything that happened to Mega Fat between getting fired from Baby Corp and getting adopted by a well-known journalist.

nick.uk.title: Popularity Papers - Odds Squads
nick.uk.description: It's Mapleview Middle's favourite school event: the treasure hunt. Every year, the school pairs off on an epic scavenger hunt and this year will be more exciting since it will be broadcast on the local news.

nick.uk.title: Rock Island Mysteries - Journey to the Bottom of the Island
nick.uk.description: Taylor, Meesha and Ellis are accidentally trapped underwater in the Institute's new submersible.

nick.uk.title: Rock Island Mysteries - Too Much Information
nick.uk.description: At a Milk Shack photo exhibition, the group can't stop telling the truth - whether they want to or not! The gang must evade Raquel before they tell her everything.

nick.uk.title: Hunter Street - Relatively Speaking
nick.uk.description: The heist doesn't go as expected and the girls discover Miss Lucas's obsession. An unexpected reveal for Daniel and Evie leaves them reeling.

nick.uk.title: Hunter Street - Enemies Within
nick.uk.description: Miss Lucas is intent on proving to Jennie and Anika that nothing suspicious is happening at the Academy; Jasmyn calls Oliver for help; the Florian situation begins to escalate beyond the Hunters' control, reaching a chilling climax.

nick.uk.title: House of Anubis - House of Defeat
nick.uk.description: Eddie and KT find the final artefact and take it to the gatehouse to destroy Ammut, only to realise they have been tricked. An evil Alfie breaks Willow's heart and Joy and Mara bond while coming to her aid.

nick.uk.title: House of Anubis - House of Ammut
nick.uk.description: Frobisher demands KT's key as Ammut begins to form. Eddie and KT realise what the keys are used for. Jerome writes a letter explaining his feelings to Joy, but she refuses to read it.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Charlotte Gets Ghosted
nick.uk.description: Schwoz invents a vacuum to help Henry clean his house, but it accidentally sucks Charlotte inside. When Henry's family hears Charlotte they think the vacuum is haunted. Ray must distract them while Henry finds a way to get her out.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - A Tale of Two Pipers
nick.uk.description: Henry gets an unexpected visitor claiming to be from the future. When a boy-robot killing machine steps onto the scene, The Gang must find a way to save everyone from an apocalyptic future.

nick.uk.title: Popularity Papers - The Wonderful Wizard of Mapleview: Part 1
nick.uk.description: Julie takes a bold stance against the controversial Mapleview People of the Year page, claiming it's an outdated popularity contest that should be abolished, only to discover it's not what she thought it was.

nick.uk.title: Rock Island Mysteries - Seashell
nick.uk.description: Taylor and her friends come across a troublesome seashell on their trip to a deserted island.

nick.uk.title: Rock Island Mysteries - Treasure Map
nick.uk.description: When a young prospector arrives onto the island with plans to find gold, Taylor and her friends do their best to foil his plans and keep the island safe.

nick.uk.title: Hunter Street - Curse or Cure?
nick.uk.description: Having figured out the workings of the mysterious map, the gang splits up in search of another riddle stone.

nick.uk.title: Hunter Street - The Second Stone
nick.uk.description: A second riddle emerges, but cracking it is tricky. However, when an emergency means the Hunter kids must return to the city, it looks like the treasure hunt is off for good.

nick.uk.title: House of Anubis - House of Sibuna
nick.uk.description: Jerome reads that his dad wants him to visit him in prison. Patricia softens towards Eddie - then finds out about his bet, while Joy and Mara sign up for the school website.

nick.uk.title: House of Anubis - House of Payback
nick.uk.description: The Sibunas need to practice laying the beam - and Victor finds the lock and the map of the tunnels, which he copies. Alfie fails to dump Amber. Patricia plans her revenge on Eddie.

nick.uk.title: House of Anubis - House of Pendulums
nick.uk.description: Victor and Vera hide in the cellar and see Nina entering the antechamber code. While the Sibunas practise dodging pendulums, Patricia's revenge on Eddie backfires.

nick.uk.title: House of Anubis - House of Impasse
nick.uk.description: Victor has been blinded by the beacon flash - and the Sibunas only just manage to avoid him. Poppy learns that her father wants to arrange a prison visit and that Jerome didn't tell her.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Cave the Date
nick.uk.description: Henry and the gang set up a secret underground restaurant in the Man Cave for Charlotte's private dinner with music superstar Jack Swagger. Word gets out that Jack Swagger is in town.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Game of Phones
nick.uk.description: When a young girl chains herself outside Junk-N-Stuff, Kid Danger and Captain Man are forced to help find her beloved phone. While on a stakeout, they unexpectedly run across some familiar faces with a devious plan.

nick.uk.title: Rock Island Mysteries - The Dig
nick.uk.description: The gang find a dinosaur fossil at the beach, and it leads to the entire beach being turned into a dig site. While Taylor, Meesha and Lila work on the fossil, Ellis and Nori help out at the South Section.

nick.uk.title: Rock Island Mysteries - The Day Uncle Charlie Went Missing
nick.uk.description: On the anniversary of Uncle Charlie's disappearance, the gang see a replica of the Bermuda Queen in the sky. They track it down to a cane field and discover that Raquel has been piloting it all along.

nick.uk.title: The Marsupilamis - Jade the Juggler; Parcel Chase
nick.uk.description: Jade helps Mica, Suzanne and Bibi, but quickly becomes overwhelmed and struggles to prevent chaos at Chahuta. The Marsupilamis miss the delivery man and chase after him to retrieve an important package.

nick.uk.title: The Smurfs - Papa Smurf Leaves the Nest
nick.uk.description: An accident in Papa Smurf's lab causes him to switch bodies with a sparrow.

nick.uk.title: The Smurfs - Fire Brigade on Foot; The Prettiest Pebble in the World
nick.uk.description: Dimwitty and Clumsy decide to get rid of the fire truck so that they no longer argue about it. But it is very difficult to put out a fire on foot. Gargamel leaves magic pebbles in the forest to hypnotise the Smurfs.

showtime.us.description: When a giant creature starts destroying Seoul, South Korea, a woman learns that she is somehow connected to the phenomenon. She must now figure out why her seemingly insignificant existence is having such a colossal effect on the fate of the world.

showtime.us.title: It Follows
showtime.us.description: Following a strange sexual encounter, a teenager (Maika Monroe) has disturbing visions and the inescapable feeling that someone -- or something -- is stalking her.

showtime.us.title: Parasite
showtime.us.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

showtime.us.title: V for Vendetta
showtime.us.description: After world war leads to a fascist government, a vigilante known as V (Hugo Weaving) uses terrorist tactics to fight the totalitarian state in which he now lives.

showtime.us.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
showtime.us.description: Seasoned warrior Sarah Connor joins forces with a hybrid cyborg human and the T-800 model to protect a young woman from the Rev-9 -- a newly modified and seemingly indestructible liquid Terminator from the future.

showtime.us.title: Bleed for This
showtime.us.description: With help from trainer Kevin Rooney, champion boxer Vinny Pazienza tries to make a comeback after breaking his neck in a car accident.

showtime.us.title: Parasite
showtime.us.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

showtime.us.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
showtime.us.description: Four teens embark on the adventure of a lifetime when a video game magically transports them to the jungle and transforms them into adults.

showtime.us.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
showtime.us.description: The owner (Vince Vaughn) of a gym and an overbearing entrepreneur (Ben Stiller) form dodgeball teams to compete for $50,000 in Las Vegas.

skycinemafamily.uk.description: On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. They hope they will be rescued soon.

skycinemafamily.uk.description: The Chipmunks believe that Dave plans to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami and dump them. They have three days to get to him and save themselves not only from losing Dave but also from gaining a terrible stepbrother.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Minecraft Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Johnny English
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Spoof spy caper with the eponymous, blundering hero attempting to recover the crown jewels and save Britain from an evil mastermind when all the other agents are killed. Promoted from lowly pen pusher to super spy, Johnny English is baffled when clues lead to respected entrepreneur Pascal Sauvage, but could the enigmatic Lorna hold the key to the mystery?

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Johnny English Reborn
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A haphazard spy returns to MI-7 after years in a Tibetan monastery honing his Zen skills. Armed with gizmos, gadgets and chaotic luck he takes on a global ring of assassins.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Johnny English Strikes Again
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Johnny English springs back into action when a hacker reveals the identities of undercover agents in Britain. As a man with few skills and analogue methods, Johnny must overcome the challenges of modern technology to make this mission a success.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When a single mother and her two children move to a new town, they soon discover that they have a connection to the original Ghostbusters and their grandfather's secret legacy.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Karate Kid: Legends
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jack the Giant Slayer
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young farmhand gets swept into the realm of legend when he must defend his land from a seemingly unstoppable force of giant warriors.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Yogi Bear
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Dog's Purpose
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Reincarnated as different dogs over the course of five decades, a lovable and devoted canine keeps reuniting with the original owner who cared for it as a young golden retriever puppy.

Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.

skycinemafamily.uk.description: A slick attorney fails to show up for his son's fifth birthday, prompting the boy to make a wish that his father would tell the truth for just one day. Miraculously, the wish is granted and for the next 24 hours, the formerly mendacious lawyer is unable to tell a single lie.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Too
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.
