fxm.us.title: The Earth Dies Screaming
fxm.us.description: An astronaut (Willard Parker) returns from a test flight to find England overtaken by alien-controlled robots which turn corpses into zombies. (Science fiction) - 1964

fxm.us.title: The Alligator People
fxm.us.description: Newly married nurse Joyce Webster (Beverly Garland) doesn't know what to think when her husband, Paul (Richard Crane), disappears during a train ride. She hires private investigators and eventually tracks him to an old bayou plantation, where the owner (Frieda Inescort) insists she's never heard of Paul. Joyce sticks around anyway and soon learns that local doctor Mark Sinclair (George Macready) has been using a life-altering alligator serum on the town's residents, and that Paul is among them. (Horror) - 1959

fxm.us.title: The Fly
fxm.us.description: When scientist Andre Delambre (Al Hedison) tests his matter transporter on himself, an errant housefly makes its way into the transportation chamber, and things go horribly wrong. As a result, Delambre's head and arm are now that of the insect. Slowly losing himself to the fly, Delambre turns to his wife, Helene (Patricia Owens), for help. But when tragedy strikes, Delambre's brother (Vincent Price) and Inspector Charas (Herbert Marshall) are forced to pick up the investigation. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1958

fxm.us.title: The Curse of the Fly
fxm.us.description: Scantily clad Patricia Stanley (Carole Gray) breaks out of a mental hospital and is picked up by passing motorist Martin Delambre (George Baker). The two do not reveal much about themselves to each other, but nevertheless decide to get married. At the Delambre family mansion, Patricia meets Martin's father, Henri (Brian Donlevy), an eccentric scientist. Snooping about the grounds, she discovers evidence of the family's strange experiments in teleportation and the grisly results thereof. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery, Drama) - 1965

fxm.us.title: Arachnophobia
fxm.us.description: After a nature photographer (Mark L. Taylor) dies on assignment in Venezuela, a poisonous spider hitches a ride in his coffin to his hometown in rural California, where arachnophobe Dr. Ross Jennings (Jeff Daniels) has just moved in with his wife, Molly (Harley Jane Kozak), and young son. As town residents start turning up dead, Jennings begins to suspect spiders, and must face his fears as he and no-nonsense exterminator Delbert McClintock (John Goodman) fight to stop a deadly infestation. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1990

fxm.us.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
fxm.us.description: Evil Judge Turpin (Alan Rickman) lusts for the beautiful wife of a London barber (Johnny Depp) and transports him to Australia for a crime he did not commit. Returning after 15 years and calling himself Sweeney Todd, the now-mad man vows revenge, applying his razor to unlucky customers and shuttling the bodies down to Mrs. Lovett (Helena Bonham Carter), who uses them in her meat-pie shop. Though many fall to his blade, he will not be satisfied until he slits Turpin's throat. (Musical, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2007

fxm.us.title: Sleepy Hollow
fxm.us.description: Constable Ichabod Crane is sent to the village of Sleepy Hollow, where a headless horseman is leaving a trail of decapitated bodies. (Horror, Fantasy, Mystery) - 1999

fxm.us.title: The Village
fxm.us.description: The population of a small, isolated countryside village believes that their alliance with the mysterious creatures that inhabit the surrounding forest is coming to an end. (Thriller, Mystery, Drama) - 2004

fxm.us.title: Moulin Rouge
fxm.us.description: A celebration of love and creative inspiration takes place in the infamous, gaudy and glamorous Parisian nightclub, at the cusp of the 20th century. A young poet (Ewan McGregor), who is plunged into the heady world of Moulin Rouge, begins a passionate affair with the club's most notorious and beautiful star (Nicole Kidman). (Musical, Drama, Romance) - 2001

fxm.us.title: Champagne Charlie
fxm.us.description: A young heiress (Helen Wood) becomes the prime suspect in the murder of a smooth gambler (Paul Cavanagh). (Mystery, Crime drama) - 1936

fxm.us.title: Berlin Correspondent
fxm.us.description: In 1941 Berlin, the Gestapo's efforts to uncover the source of vital information broadcast by American correspondent Bill Roberts remain elusive. The Gestapo colonel in charge of the investigation presses his fiancée, Karen Hauen, to help and, with reluctance, she agrees. After befriending Bill, Karen discovers how he receives the information, but when she also learns who provides it, she is exposed for the first time to the brutal tactics of her government. (Thriller) - 1942

fxm.us.title: Where the Sidewalk Ends
fxm.us.description: Ashamed that his father lived a life of crime, hard-boiled New York City cop Mark Dixon has a reputation for being too tough on criminals. So when Dixon unintentionally kills a murder suspect during a routine questioning, he hides the fact from the department and tries to pin the killing on his nemesis, notorious gangster Scalise. The snag in the cop's plan comes when his boss wrongly accuses the father of Dixon's love interest, Morgan, of the murder. (Crime drama) - 1950

fxm.us.title: Nightmare Alley
fxm.us.description: Roustabout Stanton Carlisle joins a traveling carny and unsuccessfully schemes to figure out the mind-reading act of Mademoiselle Zeena and her alcoholic husband, Pete. But when Pete dies, Zeena is forced to take on Stanton as a partner, and he quickly proves more gifted than his predecessor. Ambitious to a fault, Carlisle abandons Zeena and the carny to reinvent himself as The Great Stanton, wowing high-class audiences in a Chicago hotel. (Crime drama) - 1947

fxm.us.title: The Lodger
fxm.us.description: In London in 1889, retiree Robert Burton (Cedric Hardwicke) and his wife, Ellen (Sara Allgood), rent a spare room to the mysterious Slade (Laird Cregar) as Jack the Ripper continues to terrorize the city. The Burtons' niece, Kitty (Merle Oberon), is a music hall singer who initially grows fond of the eccentric lodger, but, when the Ripper's body count rises, she and a Scotland Yard inspector (George Sanders) gradually begin to suspect that Slade could be the notorious Whitechapel killer. (Thriller) - 1944

fxm.us.title: The Innocents
fxm.us.description: Based on the Henry James story "The Turn of the Screw," a psychological thriller about a woman who takes a governess job for two orphans in a Victorian home. She begins to see what she believes are ghosts and suspects the children's bizarre behavior is the result of supernatural powers. (Horror) - 1961

fxm.us.title: The Night House
fxm.us.description: Reeling from the unexpected death of her husband, Beth is left alone at the lakeside home he built for her. She tries her best to keep it together -- but then the nightmares come. Disturbing visions of a presence in the house call to her, beckoning Beth with a ghostly allure. She soon begins searching for answers, only to find secrets both strange and disturbing. (Horror, Thriller) - 2020

fxm.us.title: The Grudge
fxm.us.description: A detective investigates a murder scene that has a connection to a case that her new partner handled in the past. The killings occurred in a haunted house that passes on a ghostly curse to those who dare enter it. Soon, the curse spreads to a terminally ill woman and her husband, and another unsuspecting couple who were in the wrong place at the wrong time. (Horror, Thriller) - 2020

bbcamerica.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: For reasons unknown, the recently deceased are rising from the grave as flesh-hungry zombies. Fleeing from the undead horde, a small group of survivors, including Barbara (Patricia Tallman), Ben (Tony Todd) and Harry (Tom Towles), sequester themselves in a remote farmhouse. With the zombies outside the house multiplying, tensions flare, as the group argues over the best way to escape their increasingly dire situation before they are overrun completely. (Horror) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Graveyard Shift
bbcamerica.us.description: After an abandoned textile mill reopens, several employees die; the deaths occur between 11 p.m. and 7 a.m. during the graveyard shift. A mill foreman assigns a group to clean the basement; the workers find a network of tunnels leading to a cemetery and an unknown creature. (Holiday, Horror) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Thinner
bbcamerica.us.description: Billy Halleck (Robert John Burke) is an obese lawyer who accidentally hits a Gypsy with his car after his wife distracts him. Given Halleck's influence in town and a general prejudice against Gypsies, he manages to brush the incident under the rug with some unethical legal help from his associates. However, the victim's father, Tadzu Lempke (Michael Constantine), places a curse on the heavyset man, and he starts to lose weight at an alarming rate, which is followed by other macabre events. (Horror) - 1996

bbcamerica.us.title: Pet Sematary
bbcamerica.us.description: Doctor Louis Creed (Dale Midkiff) moves his family to Maine, where he meets a friendly local named Jud Crandall (Fred Gwynne). After the Creeds' cat is accidentally killed, Crandall advises Louis to bury it in the ground near the old pet cemetery. The cat returns to life, its personality changed for the worse. When Louis' son, Gage (Miko Hughes), dies tragically, Louis decides to bury the boy's body in the same ground despite the warnings of Crandall and Louis' visions of a deceased patient. (Horror, Thriller) - 1989

bbcamerica.us.title: Pet Sematary Two
bbcamerica.us.description: When his mother, Renee (Darlanne Fluegel), dies, young Jeff Matthews (Edward Furlong) moves back to his hometown with his father, Chase (Anthony Edwards). Jeff grows friendly with Drew Gilbert (Jason McGuire) at school, who tells him about the Indian burial grounds that bring people and animals back to life, which led to the deaths of the Creed family who used to live in town. Desperately missing his mom, Jeff ignores warnings and buries her corpse, only to have her return in deadly zombie form. (Horror) - 1992

bbcamerica.us.title: Misery
bbcamerica.us.description: After a serious car crash, novelist Paul Sheldon (James Caan) is rescued by former nurse Annie Wilkes (Kathy Bates), who claims to be his biggest fan. Annie brings him to her remote cabin to recover, where her obsession takes a dark turn when she discovers Sheldon is killing off her favorite character from his novels. As Sheldon devises plans for escape, Annie grows increasingly controlling, even violent, as she forces the author to shape his writing to suit her twisted fantasies. (Horror, Thriller) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Christine
bbcamerica.us.description: Unpopular nerd Arnie Cunningham (Keith Gordon) buys a 1958 Plymouth Fury, which he names Christine. Arnie develops an unhealthy obsession with the car, to the alarm of his jock friend, Dennis Guilder (John Stockwell). After bully Buddy Repperton (William Ostrander) defaces Christine, the auto restores itself to perfect condition and begins killing off Buddy and his friends. Determined to stop the deaths, Dennis and Arnie's girlfriend, Leigh Cabot (Alexandra Paul), decide to destroy Christine. (Horror) - 1983

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

hallmark.us.title: Time for Him to Come Home for Christmas
hallmark.us.description: Four days before Christmas, Elizabeth Athens receives a voicemail from a number she doesn't recognize. On the message, a man she doesn't know makes one final plea for the love of his life to give him a second chance. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Drama, Holiday, Movie) - 2022-11-26

hallmark.us.title: Merry Christmas, Ted Cooper!
hallmark.us.description: An unlucky weatherman hopes to share his Christmastime cheer with his high school crush. (Comedy, Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2025-10-25

hallmark.us.title: A Christmas Together With You
hallmark.us.description: Planning on spending the holidays alone, Megan and her father figure, Frank, go on a road trip to find his first true love. (Drama, Holiday, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 2021-11-20

hallmark.us.title: A Merry Scottish Christmas
hallmark.us.description: When estranged siblings Lindsay and Brad Morgan travel to Scotland at Christmas to reunite with their mother Jo, a big family secret is revealed. (Comedy, Drama, Holiday, Movie, Reality) - 2023-11-18

hallmark.us.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
hallmark.us.description: Sparks fly between an ambitious freelance reporter and a handsome firefighter after she lands a feel-good story about a Chicago Bears superfan who's about to attend her 500th game. (Comedy, Drama, Holiday, Movie, Romance) - 2026-10-17

hallmark.us.title: 'Twas the Date Before Christmas
hallmark.us.description: Feeling the pressure to bring someone home for Christmas, Jessie convinces Bryan to join her family for a day filled with holiday events, only the family doesn't know it's their first date. (Comedy, Drama, Holiday, Movie, Romance) - 2024-10-18

hallmark.us.title: What If Christmas
hallmark.us.description: Erin wishes for a life as a fashion designer. It comes true, but at a cost: she never married her husband, Adam, and lives a lonely life at the top. (Holiday, Movie, Romance) - 2026-10-25

hallmark.us.title: Time for Me to Come Home for Christmas
hallmark.us.description: Two strangers, a businesswoman and a country music star, are both booked on a flight to Tulsa before the holidays, but it ends up getting canceled due to a snowstorm. They decide to try to get to Tulsa together, and share their secrets along the way. (Drama, Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2018-12-09

hallmark.us.title: A Tale of Two Christmases
hallmark.us.description: Thanks to some holiday magic, Emma gets to experience two different Christmases -- one where she stays in the city and celebrates with a new crush and his friends, and one where she returns home for all the traditions with her family. (Comedy, Drama, Holiday, Movie, Romance) - 2022-11-26

hallmark.us.title: Hope at Christmas
hallmark.us.description: Sydney decides to spend Christmas in a house she inherited with her young daughter. When she meets Mac, he tries to make her Christmas wishes come true by helping her open herself up to life, love, and believing in the spirit of Christmas again. (Family, Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2018-12-29

hallmark.us.title: Christmas Waltz
hallmark.us.description: A woman makes an unexpected connection with her dance instructor after her storybook Christmas wedding is canceled. (Drama, Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2020-11-28

hallmark.us.title: One Christmas Eve
hallmark.us.description: A series of mishaps disturbs the plans of a recently divorced mom (Anne Heche) for her two kids on their first Christmas without dad. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Drama, Family, Holiday) - 2014-11-30

hallmark.us.title: The Secret Gift of Christmas
hallmark.us.description: A personal shopper helps her new client and recent widower reconnect with his young daughter, find them both everything on their wish list, and rediscover the joys of Christmas. (Comedy, Holiday, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 2023-12-15

hallmark.us.title: Christmas at Grand Valley
hallmark.us.description: Kelly returns to Grand Valley for Christmas. When Leo, a single dad, arrives in town with his kids to review a hotel, the two cross paths. As Kelly re-experiences traditions with Leo, she begins to find her way back to her passion for art. (Family, Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2018-12-21

hallmark.us.title: Noel Next Door
hallmark.us.description: A single mother gets into a war of words with an irritable neighbor who is ruining Christmas, only to find that this misunderstood Grinch is the man who has stolen her heart. (Comedy, Holiday, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 2022-10-21

hallmark.us.title: Pride, Prejudice and Mistletoe
hallmark.us.description: When Darcy returns to her hometown for Christmas, and she reconnects with Luke, a former rival, they must plan a charity event together. As she spends time with her family and Luke, she starts to realize what matters most in life. (Comedy, Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2018-11-23

hallmark.us.title: Mr. & Mrs. Christmas
hallmark.us.description: Single dad Taylor is inspired more than ever to give his two children the best Christmas in their new town. He leads the city's holiday event department, as new colleague Sophie supervises him. (Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2026-10-18

hallmark.us.title: Who's Coming for Christmas? ᴺᵉʷ
hallmark.us.description: Inspired by her late grandmother, Julie plans Christmas Eve dinner in her new home, without a guest list, and has faith that the eight seats around her table will be filled by friends and neighbors. (Comedy, Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2026-10-30

hallmark.us.title: Forgotten Holiday
hallmark.us.description: After an accident leading to sudden memory loss, Kathryn must re-date her boyfriend of one year, Rob, in an effort to get his memories back and remind him of his love of Christmas. (Comedy, Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2026-10-24

hallmark.us.title: Catch Me if You Claus
hallmark.us.description: Avery Quinn's shot at anchoring news clashes with a Santa-suited intruder, Chris, who insists he's Santa's son on a first Christmas mission. They unravel a career-making story together. (Comedy, Holiday, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 2023-11-23

hallmark.us.title: Haul Out the Holly: Lit Up
hallmark.us.description: Emily and Jared are looking forward to celebrating the holidays together again, this time as a couple. They're also ready to work with members of the community to make this year's Christmas festivities the best yet. (Comedy, Drama, Holiday, Movie, Romance) - 2023-11-25

hallmark.us.title: Cross Country Christmas
hallmark.us.description: When a snowstorm disrupts both Lina's and Max's holiday plans, they realize they must work together to find a way home -- without taking it out on each other. (Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2020-12-20

hgtvwest.us.title: Home Town
hgtvwest.us.description: S10 E08 Little Brother on a Budget Ben's little brother and his wife secretly buy a fixer-upper and plan to renovate it themselves to save money; as they move and race to finish before their third baby arrives, Ben and Erin try to convince them to accept some help.

hgtvwest.us.title: Home Town
hgtvwest.us.description: S10 E16 Unfinished Business After completing the top floor of a local architect's downtown loft, Ben and Erin return to update the second floor after a fire; Erin steps outside her comfort zone to design a modern kitchen, entertainment room, and guest suite.

hgtvwest.us.title: Home Town
hgtvwest.us.description: S10 E14 Building Champions Ben and Erin return to their alma mater, Jones College, to transform the outdated women's basketball locker room; blending nostalgic collegiate style with heart, they look to create a warm, welcoming second home for the team.

hgtvwest.us.title: Home Town
hgtvwest.us.description: S10 E09 Labor of Love With its last update 24 years ago, Ben and Erin renovate the local hospital maternity ward; it's full of family memories, including the birth of their two daughters, and they aim to transform it into a modern, welcoming space that feels like home.

hgtvwest.us.title: Castle Impossible
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E03 The Powder Rooms: Royal Flush Daphne and Ian need to stand out from the crowd to secure wedding bookings, so they turn their restrooms into luxury powder rooms; the discovery of a hidden bridge in the forest inspires them to add Renaissance-style murals to the powder room walls.

hgtvwest.us.title: Castle Impossible
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E02 Granny's Gatehouse: Part 1 After a request from Daphne's grandmother to move back to the castle, Daphne and Ian face another challenge as they renovate a derelict building in the property: the château gatehouse.

hgtvwest.us.title: Castle Impossible
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E04 Granny and the Gutted Gatehouse: Part Two Granny expresses shock at the unfinished state of the gatehouse interior; Daphne and Ian install a castle view mezzanine, find a statement chandelier at Tony's in Normandy and add special touches for Charlie the cat.

hgtvwest.us.title: Renovation Aloha
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E08 High Stakes on the Lake Kamohai and Tristyn put their all on the line as they attempt their priciest flip to date.

hgtvwest.us.title: Renovation Aloha
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E07 Toughest Clients Ever Tristyn takes on her toughest design client ever: her in-laws; the Kalamas tackle a renovation of Kamohai's childhood home for his parents, and with their annual Christmas party approaching, tensions rise to finish in time for a memorable holiday.

hgtvwest.us.title: Renovation Aloha
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E05 Ohana Overhaul When Kamohai and Tristyn buy a family home from Kamohai's cousin, they're torn between honoring generations of Kalama legacy and making the numbers work.

hgtvwest.us.title: Renovation Aloha
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E01 The Cockroach House When the Kalamas take on a roach-infested Manoa fixer, they think they've scored big, until demo reveals plumbing disasters, termite damage and a budget-busting surprise; to save the flip, they bet on a secondary suite and a smart backyard reset.

hgtvwest.us.title: Renovation Aloha
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E02 Squatter Shutdown When an off-island investor begs the Kalamas to rescue her rental disaster, they inherit unpaid rent, a hostile squatter and a house they've never seen; after a tense cash-for-keys deal, HOA battles and material delays threaten to wipe out profit.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S206 E04 From Courtroom to Coast in San José del Cabo After years as a Dallas prosecutor, a woman and her husband are moving to their favorite vacation destination of San José del Cabo, Mexico. She's ready to pay for peace and a view, but he's staring a new business and wants to keep expenses as low.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S207 E06 Big Dreams on a New Pitch in Nottingham After months of moving across Europe, a family looks to put down roots in Nottingham, England; with a dream job, a new stay-at-home parent and a child who has spent half his life on the road, they need to find a home that truly fits everyone's needs.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S208 E14 New York Breakup, Madrid Makeover After a decade in New York City, a breakup leads a woman to relocate to Madrid; she has a friend along to help in the search, and she wants a place near the city center, but she may have to compromise between price and location.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S205 E07 Kauai to Kiwi in Dunedin, New Zealand Deep family roots has led a woman to pursue a Ph.d program in Dunedin, New Zealand; her husband's leaving a dream job behind in Hawaii and wants good views, but on a tight budget, finding a place that's walkable to the university may be a challenge.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International ᴺᵉʷ
hgtvwest.us.description: S212 E11 Leave the Nest: Australia and Vietnam This spin-off of the wildly popular HGTV House Hunters goes around the globe. Home hunters and their realtors check out all sorts of architectural styles and work through the quirks of buying real estate in other countries.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International ᴺᵉʷ
hgtvwest.us.description: S212 E13 A Wild Life in Puerto Viejo, Costa Rica Her sales job pays the bills, but her heart's with her rescue dog and wildlife conservation.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S202 E12 Pressing Restart in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico A California couple leaves it all behind to start anew in their favorite vacation spot of Puerto Vallarta, Mexico; they have a wish list, but they may need to compromise on their ideal location to find a place that has everything they want.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S202 E02 New Business and New Life in Koh Samui, Thailand A neurokinetic therapist seeks a home and business in Koh Samui after visiting Thailand for years; he wants a place like his usual rentals but may compromise due to rising prices.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S199 E01 Civilization or Serenity in Roero, Italy A couple searches for a forever home in their favorite vacation destination of Roero, Italy. He's burned out from work in Vancouver and is looking for a lifestyle transformation in the countryside, but she isn't ready to give up city life just yet.

hgtvwest.us.description: S205 E07 Kauai to Kiwi in Dunedin, New Zealand Deep family roots has led a woman to pursue a Ph.d program in Dunedin, New Zealand; her husband's leaving a dream job behind in Hawaii and wants good views, but on a tight budget, finding a place that's walkable to the university may be a challenge.

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E06 The Final Fright In the season finale, the final two designers stand with only the dining room and kitchen restorations between them and $50,000! Tempers flare and even the house seems to protest as the designers face a tough battle to claim victory.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S208 E09 Big Top in Melbourne, Australia A high-flying acrobat looks to move from New York for circus training in Melbourne, Australia. She's looking for a place on her own that's near school with plenty of room to train, but on her tight budget, she may have to consider roommates.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S208 E18 Love at First Swipe in Da Nang After meeting on a dating app, two digital nomads take a leap of faith and move in together in Da Nang, Vietnam; he wants something small that's close to the beach, but she prefers a larger place that's more central to downtown.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S207 E04 From Seattle Showers to Okinawa Shores A couple leaves dreary Seattle for a lifelong dream to live on a beachy island in Okinawa, Japan; she wants to be close to the beach while he prefers something walkable near town, but on one income, finding what they both want may be a challenge.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S208 E12 Rocking the Boat in Amsterdam Seizing a new job opportunity, a single woman takes a leap of faith and moves from Dallas to Amsterdam. She's looking for a place near the city center, but in an extremely difficult housing market, she may have to make a few compromises.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S208 E06 Songs in the Key of Wife in Estepona, Spain A flight attendant who's also a classical pianist looks to reconnect with her husband in Estepona, Spain. He's a music producer and prefers a quiet place to be creative, but she's strong-willed and wants to be immersed in the city's culture.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S209 E01 Paris Dreams, Suburban Schemes After meeting and living in Canada, a married couple is moving back to his home country of France. He wants to live the typical Paris lifestyle surrounded by the bustling city, but his husband is pushing for the suburbs to get more space.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S209 E14 Love, Listings, and Maybe a Ring in Lisbon An unmarried long-distance couple takes the plunge and looks for a home together in Lisbon, Portugal. It's a test of whether they're ready for a bigger commitment, so their search may become more than just finding a house.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S210 E01 Puerto Morelos Heat Swap After nearly 30 years keeping Alberta warm with their HVAC business, empty nesters crave some heat of their own; drawn back to Puerto Morelos after many trips, they plan a bold move to Mexico for sun, culture, and a slower pace.

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E01 Welcome to the Haunted House Six designers tackle one of America's haunted houses while living in it; the scariest part isn't facing the spirits, but the four-day deadline to renovate two bedrooms, the risk of elimination and missing out on the chance to win $50,000.

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E02 Ghosts in the Gathering Rooms The five remaining designers divide into teams to revive Bihl Manor's living room and parlor; as ambitious feature projects test their skills, they'll fight to honor the home's storied past and avoid becoming the next design casualty.

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E03 Enter if You Dare Four designers remain in the competition to bring the once-grand Bihl Manor back to life; split into two teams, they'll revive the haunted halls on the first and second floors, but will the spirits and judges approve?

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E04 A Game of Haunts The four remaining designers split into two teams to transform the attic into both a spooky speakeasy and a gothic game room; but first, a spine-tingling game brings haunted surprises, pushing their nerves and upcycled feature projects to the limit.

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E05 The Exterior Exorcism For the first time, each designer tackles a space of their own as they transform Bihl Manor's neglected exterior; battling the spirits and the elements, they're aiming to give the grounds a glow-up worthy of the judges.

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E06 The Final Fright In the season finale, the final two designers stand with only the dining room and kitchen restorations between them and $50,000! Tempers flare and even the house seems to protest as the designers face a tough battle to claim victory.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S17 E04 My Lottery Scream Cabin A couple scratch off a $2 million winner and are ready to escape the heat of Florida summers; they send David on the hunt for a big holiday cabin in the Blue Ridge Mountains of Georgia.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S19 E03 Snow Place Like Home in Hub 2.0 A lucky couple's ready to add a second dream hub to their collection! David has already found them a Florida beach hub, and now they're calling on him once again to search for a snowy fairytale cabin in the Pocono Mountains of Pennsylvania.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S17 E02 Mega Mountain Dreams A couple missed winning a $1.6 billion jackpot by one number, but they did have all the numbers to win $1 million dollars; now, they're calling on David to help realize their dream of owning a mountain lodge in the forests of New Hampshire.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S16 E04 Below Dock A woman is left an inheritance from her parents and decides to honor their memory by buying a generational vacation home on the Emerald Coast; David embarks on a pilgrimage for perfection as he searches for some real waterfront showstoppers.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S14 E06 Myrtle Beach Moves When a Pennsylvanian woman receives an inheritance, it gives her the opportunity to move to the warm shores of Myrtle Beach, S.C.; David helps her and her bestie navigate beach real estate to find her forever home.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S13 E09 A Snowbirder's Florida Haven Thanks to a family inheritance, a Midwestern couple are ready for the relaxing vibes of central Florida; they're bringing in David to help search for their forever home, and now it's a decision between a golf course view and a relaxing rural outlook.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S16 E09 Low Country Comfort Connecticut teachers struck it lucky just when they are ready to retire; David helps realize their dream of finding a forever home in the beach loving, low country of South Carolina where there is lots of water, boating and scenery.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S19 E13 Single Mom Defies the Odds Despite limited finances, a single mom has made a loving, thriving home for her three children; and now after a million-dollar lottery win, she's calling on David Bromstad to help her.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S19 E07 BFF Lottery David brings along his bestie to help another pair of besties find a dream home for a daughter in Rochester, N.Y.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home ᴺᵉʷ
hgtvwest.us.description: Scratch Offs: The Second Time Around With bonus features and pop-ups: a surprise inheritance offers a Long Island couple the chance to start over in North Carolina after facing several setbacks.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S19 E10 Second Chance Love in Boston Former high school friends went their separate ways and reconnected later in life; they're newlyweds and after a million-dollar lottery win, they're calling on David to find a dream home to entertain their family and friends in Boston.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters ᴺᵉʷ
hgtvwest.us.description: S281 E03 There's No Business Like Home Business A couple who fell in love on the stage are stepping into their next roles as homeowners in suburban Pennsylvania. But with low inventory and wildly different price ranges, the stage is set for a tough search.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S278 E12 Bring On the Ghosts A proud country gal is ready to find a second property in the Kentucky wilderness; she wants plenty of land to hunt and fish with her daughter and for a potential side business, but her friend is concerned that she may be taking on too much.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S280 E02 Multi-Gen Mess A young family searches for a historic home in Saint Paul, Minnesota; they're looking for a place that can also accommodate his mom, but his wife and mother are at odds over nearly everything, and he finds himself just trying to keep the peace.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S276 E06 Six Years No House Six years into her search, a single mother in Maryland is looking for a fixer-upper with space for an ADU to bring in rental income; her family, however, is urging her to find something move-in ready so she can finally move out of her parents' place.

retroplex.us.title: The Red Stallion
retroplex.us.description: Elderly Aggie Curtis is in financial trouble and must come up with cash or sell the horse ranch she runs with her orphaned grandson, Joel. Hoping to save the ranch, Joel decides to train his favorite horse, a stallion named Red, to race. This proves to be no easy task, though -- while Red is speedy, he's also quite unruly. But the Curtises' wealthy neighbor, Moresby, takes an interest in buying Red, and Joel must consider selling his animal pal. (Adventure) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: John Ford Goes to War
retroplex.us.description: Director John Ford produces war films for the armed forces; Kris Kristofferson narrates. (Special, Documentary) - 2002-12-07

retroplex.us.title: The Jackie Robinson Story
retroplex.us.description: After a successful baseball career in college and as a coach in the military, Jackie Robinson (playing himself) attracts the attention of Major League Baseball's Branch Rickey (Minor Watson). Rickey wants Robinson to play in the minor leagues, believing he can become the first player to break the color barrier and play in the majors. The only catch: He is forbidden from defending himself against racial bigotry. Supported by his wife (Ruby Dee), Robinson is steadfast in his determination to win. (Biography) - 1950

retroplex.us.title: A Huey P. Newton Story
retroplex.us.description: A radical (Roger Guenveur Smith) from Oakland, Calif., establishes the Black Panther Party based on his 10-point program for social reform. (Biography) - 2001

retroplex.us.title: Panhandle
retroplex.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Oklahoma Annie
retroplex.us.description: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day. (Western, Comedy) - 1952

retroplex.us.title: Little Big Horn
retroplex.us.description: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor). (Historical drama) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: John Wayne Behind-the-Scenes: Filming of Stunts, Chases, Fights, Crashes & Gun Battles
retroplex.us.description: Rare production features, TV clips, and special promos provide a behind-the-scenes look at the stunts, fights, gun battles and chases from John Wayne movies including "Stagecoach," "War Wagon," "Brannigan" and "McLintock." (Special, Documentary, Biography, Entertainment) - 2017-01-01

retroplex.us.title: McLintock!
retroplex.us.description: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter. (Western, Comedy) - 1963

retroplex.us.title: Border Badmen
retroplex.us.description: After the death of a rich and very distant cousin, bumbling cowboy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) convinces his pal Billy (Buster Crabbe) to travel with him to the dead man's estate to try to claim the fortune. When they arrive, they meet Helen Stockton (Lorraine Miller), the rightful heir to the estate, but the cousin's scheming superintendent wants the inheritance for himself, so he sends his henchmen after Fuzzy, Billy and Helen. The trio must thwart the crooks and vie for the money. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.description: A cowboy escorts a young half-Native American girl, whose mother has recently died. He must find her white father in order to claim her hefty inheritance. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Panhandle
retroplex.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Treasure of Ruby Hills
retroplex.us.description: Cattlemen Reynolds (Barton MacLane) and Payne (Charles Fredericks) use their influence to edge less powerful ranchers out of the bountiful Ruby Hills Valley, then set their sights on eliminating each another. While they're busy fighting over the land, the peace-minded Ross Haney (Zachary Scott) buys up all the water rights to the valley. But Haney's bid for order is disrupted by Doran (Dick Foran), a scheming third rancher, who supplies the warring parties with deadly gunfighters. (Western) - 1955

retroplex.us.title: Oklahoma Annie
retroplex.us.description: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day. (Western, Comedy) - 1952

retroplex.us.title: Susanna Pass
retroplex.us.description: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Little Big Horn
retroplex.us.description: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor). (Historical drama) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
retroplex.us.description: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Brother Outlaw
retroplex.us.description: A man is framed for bank robbery, prompting his brother to spring him from jail. Their search for the real culprits ends in a violent confrontation with a famed gunfighter. (Western) - 1971

retroplex.us.title: Sitting Bull
retroplex.us.description: Recognizing that Maj. Robert Parrish (Dale Robertson) has a history of making peace with Native American tribes, President Ulysses S. Grant (John Hamilton) sends him to iron out a land dispute with Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish). Though negotiations seem to be going well, Parrish can't stop the deadly Battle of Little Big Horn. Many die, but when he helps Sitting Bull survive, Parrish is charged with crimes against the government, and he will be executed unless Grant steps in. (Western) - 1954

retroplex.us.title: McLintock!
retroplex.us.description: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter. (Western, Comedy) - 1963

retroplex.us.title: John Wayne Behind-the-Scenes: Filming of Stunts, Chases, Fights, Crashes & Gun Battles
retroplex.us.description: Rare production features, TV clips, and special promos provide a behind-the-scenes look at the stunts, fights, gun battles and chases from John Wayne movies including "Stagecoach," "War Wagon," "Brannigan" and "McLintock." (Special, Documentary, Biography, Entertainment) - 2017-01-01

retroplex.us.title: The Unforgiven
retroplex.us.description: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. A stranger (Joseph Wiseman) appears and disturbs their bucolic existence by spreading a malicious rumor that their adopted daughter, Rachel (Audrey Hepburn), is a Kiowa Native American. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa. (Drama, Romance, Western) - 1960

retroplex.us.title: The Blood of Heroes
retroplex.us.description: Another woman joins a future gladiator's band of "juggers" against fighters of the ruling elite. (Action, Science fiction) - 1989

retroplex.us.title: Jericho
retroplex.us.description: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho. (Western, Mystery) - 2000

Gameplay takes place on a giant version of the iconic game board, as contestants battle it out over a range of play-along question categories to win wedges and beat each other to the center. The victor then takes on a dramatic finale against the clock to claim the big money jackpot.

backstage.us.title: Synchronic
backstage.us.description: When New Orleans paramedics and longtime best friends Steve and Dennis are called to a series of bizarre and gruesome accidents, they chalk it up to a mysterious new drug found at the scene. But after Dennis' oldest daughter disappears, Steve stumbles upon a terrifying truth about the supposed psychedelic that will challenge everything he knows about reality -- and the flow of time itself. (Science fiction, Thriller) - 2019

backstage.us.title: Fast Color
backstage.us.description: Hunted by mysterious forces, a young woman who has supernatural abilities must go on the run when her powers are discovered. With nowhere else to go, she flees back to her family and the farmhouse she abandoned long ago. There, while being pursued by the local sheriff, she begins to mend the broken relationships with her mother and daughter and learns that the power she needed was inside her all along. (Science fiction, Thriller, Drama) - 2018

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge. (Drama) - 1997

backstage.us.title: Brooklyn's Finest

Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. backstage.us.title: City of Lies
backstage.us.description: Los Angeles Police Department detective Russell Poole has spent years trying to solve his biggest case -- the murders of The Notorious B.I.G. and Tupac Shakur -- but after two decades, the investigation remains open. Jack Jackson, a reporter desperate to save his reputation and career, is determined to find out why. In search of the truth, the two team up and unravel a growing web of institutional corruption and lies. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 2018

backstage.us.title: Lord of War
backstage.us.description: The 20-year arms dealing career of Queens, N.Y., outcast Yuri Orlov (Nicolas Cage) serves as a window onto the end of the Cold War and the emergence of worldwide terrorism. He finds himself reassuring his more ethically challenged younger brother, Vitaly (Jared Leto), while adeptly sidestepping the pursuit of federal agent Jack Lawrence (Ethan Hawke). The globetrotting arms dealer also pursues the woman of his dreams, supermodel Ava Fontaine (Bridget Moynahan). (Drama, Action) - 2005

backstage.us.title: The Boondock Saints
backstage.us.description: Tired of the crime overrunning the streets of Boston, Irish Catholic twin brothers Conner (Sean Patrick Flanery) and Murphy (Norman Reedus) are inspired by their faith to cleanse their hometown of evil with their own brand of zealous vigilante justice. As they hunt down and kill one notorious gangster after another, they become controversial folk heroes in the community. cinevault.us.title: Crazy in Alabama
cinevault.us.description: In 1965, eccentric Lucille Vinson murders her abusive husband, chops off his head and flees to Hollywood to pursue television fame. Back in her Alabama hometown, nephew Peejoe Bullis witnesses the killing of a young black man by racist sheriff John Doggett and is unsure whether he should testify against him. When the law catches up with Lucille, she returns home, where Peejoe is becoming increasingly involved with the civil rights movement. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1999-09-09

cinevault.us.title: Mortal Thoughts
cinevault.us.description: A loathsome man ends up dead, but it's not clear who's to blame. If ever a person got what he deserved, it's James Urbanski (Bruce Willis), an abusive drunk who steals from his wife, Joyce (Glenne Headly), and promises her close friend Cynthia Kellogg (Demi Moore) that she'll be the next target of his rage. At a group outing, James bleeds to death after someone cuts his throat. But because he's such a terrible human being, police aren't sure which of his acquaintances decided to kill him. (Drama, Movie) - 1991-04-19

cinevault.us.title: 7 Seconds
cinevault.us.description: Gangsters kidnap a thief (Tamzin Outhwaite) after her partner (Wesley Snipes) mistakenly steals a highly valuable painting. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2005-06-28

cinevault.us.title: Hard Luck
cinevault.us.description: A former criminal (Wesley Snipes) goes on the run with a stripper (Jacquelyn Quinones) after a drug deal goes bad. (Action, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2006-10-17

cinevault.us.title: The Art of War
cinevault.us.description: He is both agent and weapon - a critical line of defense for the Secretary General of the United Nations. He does not even officially exist. Neil Shaw, an American agent who must uncover an international plot to bring down the United Nations on the eve of an historic summit with China. A mysterious chain of events leads to the murder of the Chinese U.N. Ambassador. When Shaw is accused of the crime, he must go underground -- in effect, vanish from his own life. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2000-08-23

cinevault.us.title: The Replacement Killers
cinevault.us.description: Hired assassin John Lee (Chow Yun-Fat) is asked by Chinatown crime boss Terence Wei (Kenneth Tsang) to murder the young son of policeman Stan Zedkov (Michael Rooker). Lee has the boy in his sights, but his conscience gets the better of him, and he spares the child's life. Afraid that Wei will take revenge on his family in China, Lee seeks out expert forger Meg Coburn (Mira Sorvino) to obtain the passport he needs to get out of the country, but a band of replacement killers is soon on his trail. (Action, Movie) - 1998

cinevault.us.title: Half Past Dead
cinevault.us.description: Criminal mastermind Donny/49er One (Morris Chestnut) has set in motion a plan to infiltrate a high-tech prison in order to persuade a death row inmate to reveal the whereabouts of $200 million worth of gold. Undercover FBI agent Sascha (Steven Seagal) must stop him before it's too late. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2002-11-15

cinevault.us.title: Sahara
cinevault.us.description: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole. (Movie, War) - 1995-04-25

cinevault.us.title: Fugitive Nights: Danger in the Desert
cinevault.us.description: A Palm Springs private eye (Teri Garr) wants two policemen (Sam Elliott, Thomas Haden Church) to help her catch a fugitive. (Movie, Mystery) - 1993-11-19

cinevault.us.title: Finding Graceland
cinevault.us.description: En route to Memphis, Tenn., on a solemn solo road trip, widower Byron Gruman picks up a disarming hitchhiker who claims to be the late, great Elvis Presley. As Gruman opens up about the loss of his wife, Beatrice, in a tragic car accident, his bizarre passenger becomes a surprisingly powerful source of wisdom and comfort. The duo even picks up a Marilyn Monroe impersonator, Ashley, during the surreal pilgrimage to Graceland. (Drama, Movie) - 1998

filmriseclassictv.us.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
filmriseclassictv.us.description: This series follows the Clampett family from the Ozarks to posh Beverly Hills after they strike oil and become millionaires. Banker Mr. Drysdale tries to keep them from foolishly spending their newfound wealth, and he also tries to "civilize" them -- usually succeeding in making a fool of himself in the process. (Sitcom) - 1962-09-26

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmriseaction.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmriseaction.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You

He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty). (Dark comedy, Crime drama) - 1989

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Homeboy
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby. (Drama) - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Direct Contact

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Baby Gone
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Emily, who is pregnant, quickly becomes friends with her new, pregnant neighbor. Little does Emily know that Kelly has been faking her pregnancy so she can steal her baby. (Thriller) - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Straight A's
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: At the behest of his mother's ghost, an addict (Ryan Phillippe) returns to his Louisiana home, where he must confront an ex-lover (Anna Paquin) who is now married to his brother. (Romantic comedy) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them. (Drama) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

shadesofblack.us.title: Foxy Brown
shadesofblack.us.description: Unable to pay back the $20,000 he owes the mob, small-time hustler Link (Antonio Fargas) instead gives up the identity of an undercover cop (Terry Carter) who happens to be dating his sister, Foxy Brown (Pam Grier). When gangsters later kill the cop, Foxy is quick to make the connection and swears vengeance. Posing as a prostitute, and with the help of a group of neighborhood vigilantes, she gradually tracks down the hit men, their Mafia bosses and her own brother. (Crime drama) - 1974

shadesofblack.us.title: Judgment Day
shadesofblack.us.description: In 72 hours a meteor will collide with Earth and annihilate mankind. Singapore's government tells its citizens to let loose for once and do absolutely anything they please. (Comedy drama) - 2013

shadesofblack.us.title: Armed Response
shadesofblack.us.description: Trained operatives find themselves trapped inside an isolated military compound after its artificial intelligence is suddenly shut down. There, they begin to experience strange and horrific phenomena. (Horror, Thriller, Action) - 2017

shadesofblack.us.title: Fifty Shades of Black
shadesofblack.us.description: In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," Hannah Steele interviews entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) for her roommate's school newspaper. The wealthy and eligible Black quickly learns how clumsy the young woman is. As flirtation leads to attraction, Christian invites Hannah to his home and introduces her to his kinky world of S&M. Despite their different backgrounds, the new couple consistently surprise each other with how far they're willing to go to make their relationship work. (Comedy) - 2016

shadesofblack.us.title: Who's Your Caddy?
shadesofblack.us.description: Superstar rap mogul C-Note (Antwan "Big Boi" Patton) wants to join the Carolina Pines Golf & Country Club, but faces stiff opposition from the establishment's snooty members. C-Note forces the issue by purchasing the land adjacent to the golf course's 17th hole. As the club leaders search for a way to revoke his membership, C-Note realizes his family's honor and golf history are at stake, and digs in for the fight of his life. (Comedy) - 2007

shadesofblack.us.title: Holiday Heart
shadesofblack.us.description: After losing his police officer lover, Christian drag queen Holiday Heart (Ving Rhames) meets 12-year-old Niki (Jessika Quynn Reynolds) and her drug-addicted mother, Wanda (Alfre Woodard). Heart finds relief from heartache and a renewed sense of purpose when he steps in as a father figure to Niki and welcomes the two women into his life. But when Wanda becomes romantically involved with her drug dealer, Silas, it may endanger Niki and threaten to destroy the makeshift family. (Drama, LGBTQ) - 2000

shadesofblack.us.title: Soul Men
shadesofblack.us.description: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater. (Comedy) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: The Last Letter
shadesofblack.us.description: Catherine Wright struggles with a debilitating sleep disorder. Her husband Michael struggles to cope when their newborn son lies awake. (Thriller) - 2012

shadesofblack.us.title: Original Gangstas
shadesofblack.us.description: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence. (Action) - 1996

shadesofblack.us.title: Shottas
shadesofblack.us.description: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways. (Crime drama) - 2002

shadesofblack.us.title: Reggie Yates' Extreme South Africa - The Millionaire Preacher
shadesofblack.us.description: Reggie Yates gets up close and personal with three very different communities in South Africa, exploring what life is like for the people living here. (Documentary, Travel) - 2014-03-03

shadesofblack.us.title: State Property
shadesofblack.us.description: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash). (Crime drama) - 2002

outlaw.us.title: There Was a Crooked Man
outlaw.us.description: After a botched heist, Wild West bandit Paris Pitman Jr. (Kirk Douglas) hides his newly stolen money where no one will find it, then loses his entire gang in a blaze of bullets before being captured by the law and given a lengthy sentence in a desert jail. Paris believes that he can buy his way out of his predicament by offering some cash to the guards, but the upstanding Sheriff Lopeman (Henry Fonda) makes sure his men remain honest. Running out of options, Paris begins plotting a jailbreak. (Western) - 1970

outlaw.us.title: Wichita
outlaw.us.description: After a group of drunken trail riders runs amok, Mayor Andrew Hope (Carl Benton Reid) of Wichita, Kan., recruits the intrepid Wyatt Earp (Joel McCrea) to end lawlessness. Armed and ready for anything, the new marshal decides he will end gun violence simply by banning guns. Soon Earp must face crooked rancher Clint Wallace (Walter Sande) and whiskey slinger Doc Black (Edgar Buchanan), vicious locals who like Wichita exactly as it is and don't take kindly to being told what to do. (Western) - 1955

outlaw.us.title: Run of the Arrow
outlaw.us.description: A postwar Confederate passes a challenging Dakota ritual, takes a bride and then joins attacks on the cavalry. (Western) - 1957

outlaw.us.title: Dirty Dingus Magee
outlaw.us.description: While traveling in New Mexico, Hoke Birdsill is robbed by Dirty Dingus Magee, a bumbling criminal. So when Hoke arrives in the nearest town, Yerkey's Hole, he demands justice from Belle Nops, the town's mayor and the madam of the local bordello. In response, Belle deputizes Hoke. Despite Hoke's best efforts, however, Dirty Dingus Magee continues to stir up trouble, aided by his American Indian lover, Anna Hot Water. (Western, Comedy) - 1970

outlaw.us.title: Many Rivers to Cross
outlaw.us.description: Headstrong Mary Stuart Cherne (Eleanor Parker) is in hot pursuit of frontiersman Bushrod Gentry (Robert Taylor), and is determined to make him her husband. Naturally, Bushrod has no desire to leave the happy, wandering life of a trapper. He heads north to escape Mary's nuptial advances. But with hostile Shawnee Indians at every turn, Bushrod and Mary must set aside their differences and work together to survive the wilds of the unfamiliar territory. (Western, Comedy) - 1955

outlaw.us.title: Colt .45
outlaw.us.description: While gun purveyor Steve Farrell (Randolph Scott) shows off the latest revolver innovation, a Colt .45 repeating handgun, to Sheriff Harris (Alan Hale), outlaw prisoner Jason Brett (Zachary Scott) grabs a pair and hightails it out of town -- and the sheriff jails Farrell as a likely partner in crime. But during Farrell's incarceration, Brett goes on an unstoppable rampage. Farrell is released, and must stop the outlaw with the assistance of Walking Bear (Chief Thundercloud) and the Colt .45. (Western) - 1950

outlaw.us.title: Thunder Over the Plains
outlaw.us.description: It's the late 1860s, and the U.S. government has yet to reclaim Texas as a state. A group of opportunistic and amoral Northerners head south to claim the territory as their own. Though Texas lawman Capt. Porter (Randolph Scott) believes it's his duty to honor the local leaders, he can't ignore the corruption of the Yankee politicians who are giving him orders. When Confederate veteran Ben (Charles McGraw) is unjustly sentenced to death, Porter decides he has had enough of his new bosses. (Western) - 1953

outlaw.us.title: Kansas Pacific
outlaw.us.description: With the American Civil War looming, construction of the Pacific railroad is being held up in Kansas, sabotaged by Confederate sympathizers. The government dispatches an Army engineer, John Nelson (Sterling Hayden), to oversee construction, and he initially rubs the wrong way both his proud boss (Barton MacLane) and his boss's feisty daughter (Eve Miller). Eventually, though, both fall for Nelson's charms, and the hero seeks to uncover the Southern rat so he can lead the Union men due west. (Western) - 1953

outlaw.us.title: Advance to the Rear
outlaw.us.description: As punishment for their incompetence in battle, disgraced Union soldier Capt. Jared Heath (Glenn Ford) and his apathetic commanding officer, Col. Claude Brackenbury (Melvyn Douglas), are reassigned away from the front lines. The hapless Heath and Brackenbury must now lead a ragtag group on a classified mission to protect a transport for the U.S. Treasury. Complicating matters is Martha Lou Williams (Stella Stevens), a Confederate agent posing as a lady of the evening. (Western, Comedy) - 1964

outtvproud.us.title: Frankenstein
outtvproud.us.description: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist. (Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2004

outtvproud.us.title: Bitch Slap
outtvproud.us.description: Three bad girls, a stripper, a drug-runner, and a power broker, arrive in the desert to extort money from an underworld kingpin, but things quickly spin out of control as allegiances change. (Action) - 2009

outtvproud.us.title: Backtrack
outtvproud.us.description: While fixing a flat tire, artist Anne Benton (Jodie Foster) sees a mob killing. She reports the murder to the local police, but they are unable to protect her from Mafia don Lino Avoca (Vincent Price), who orders hitman Milo (Dennis Hopper) to track her down and kill her. Anne changes her identity, moves to Seattle and builds a new life, while Milo, preparing for his mission, becomes increasingly obsessed with her. When he finally finds Anne, Milo needs to decide what his next move will be. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1989

outtvproud.us.title: Wisegirls
outtvproud.us.description: Low on money and fresh out of hope, aspiring doctor Meg Kennedy is forced to return home to Staten Island, N.Y., where she finds work as a waitress at Santalino's, a boisterous Italian restaurant. Soon, Meg befriends coworkers Raychel and Kate and begins a new life. But after Meg discovers that Santalino's is a mob front, she finds herself deep in danger, and is recruited by the police to spy on her criminally connected boss. (Crime drama) - 2002

outtvproud.us.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Part 2
outtvproud.us.description: Chainsaw-wielding maniac Leatherface (Bill Johnson) is up to his cannibalistic ways once again, along with the rest of his twisted clan, including the equally disturbed Chop-Top (Bill Moseley).
