truehistory.us.description: The Mogao Grottoes, dug out of cliffs in the desert of northwestern China, contain one of the most dazzling collections of Buddhist art in the world. (Travel) - 2022-06-06

truehistory.us.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places - Persepolis, the Great Persian Capital
truehistory.us.description: The citadel of Persepolis was the capital of the Achaemenid Empire for nearly 200 years. (Travel) - 2022-06-08

truehistory.us.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places - Easter Island and the Moai
truehistory.us.description: The moai, the colossal statues of Easter Island, are a testament to human innovation. (Travel) - 2022-06-08

truehistory.us.title: Herodotus: The Father of History - Herodotus and History
truehistory.us.description: Identifying key issues of definition and terminology; explaining what is known about the life of Herodotus; background on the ancient Greek world; summarizing the momentous events, particularly the Persian Wars, that spur Herodotus to write. (Educational) - 2002-03-11

truehistory.us.title: Herodotus: The Father of History - \"Inquiry\" and the Birth of History
truehistory.us.description: Herodotus is not the first Greek to write about the past; knowing makes him original; how he explains, in the very first sentence of his work and one that richly rewards close reading, the what, why and how of his monumental effort. (Educational) - 2002-03-11

truehistory.us.title: Herodotus: The Father of History - Myth, Legend, and Oral Tradition
truehistory.us.description: Knowing how Herodotus deals with the vast and complicated body of traditional narratives that inform the Greek world; how his subject and his angle on it both resemble and differ from older accounts of the ways and causes of things. (Educational) - 2002-03-11

truehistory.us.title: Herodotus: The Father of History - Homeric Epic and the East-West Conflict
truehistory.us.description: For all ancient Greeks, Homer is a pervasive influence; Herodotus models his work on the "Iliad" and the "Odyssey," yet he departs from the Homeric and gives the uniquely Herodotean perspective. (Educational) - 2002-03-11

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - The Meaning of Evolution
truehistory.us.description: Pondering why Darwin is so revolutionary; his breakthrough is not in introducing the idea of evolution, which has long been debated, but in proposing how evolution occurs; surveying these and other themes that are developed in the course. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - The Way It Used to Be
truehistory.us.description: Examining the traditional worldview in the West, which is based on the biblical account of creation fixed at 4004 B.C.; an allied idea is the Great Chain of Being, pictured as an immutable scale of life forms from the most primitive to God himself. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - Theories of Evolution in the 18th Century
truehistory.us.description: Studying three 18th-century thinkers; Benoit de Maillet, who estimates the age of the cosmos; Georges Buffon, who believes living things descend from more primal forms; Pierre Simon Laplace, who proposes a theory for the solar system's formation. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - Fossils and Catastrophism
truehistory.us.description: At the end of the 18th century, fossils are not necessarily regarded as actual remains of living things; they become central to the work of Georges Cuvier, who connects them to extinct species which he believes died out in violent catastrophes. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius - The Hidden Teaching Dynamic of the Analects
truehistory.us.description: Getting a broader view of Confucius and his style of teaching; examining how the text's performative nature holds its diverse teachings together; exploring Confucius's mission to return China to a more harmonious era in its history. (Books & literature) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius - The Analects: A Bird's-Eye View
truehistory.us.description: The "Analects" should not just be read, but lived; how to enter the book's world by considering Confucius's imaginative ideas about living in society; practicing one's ability to navigate through the book's tangle of information and questions. (Books & literature) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius - The Man We Call Confucius
truehistory.us.description: Who Confucius is; how he manages to become one of the most important figures in world history; what historians know about Confucius; the opinions of thinkers like Mencius and Xunzi; several illuminating passages from Chapter 10 of the "Analects". (Books & literature) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius - How the Analects Is Organized
truehistory.us.description: The structure of the "Analects" offers a helpful way to understand the text's deeper meanings: breaking down Confucius's book into its chapters, the scattered nature of its tiny nuggets of knowledge, and the generations of historical commentary. (Books & literature) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - History on a Geological Scale
truehistory.us.description: Taking a virtual walk from the Washington Monument to the U.S. Capitol to explore the 4.54 billion-year history of Earth, with each stride representing 1 to 2 million years; along the way, fossils paint a picture of life on Earth from its start. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Life Cast in Ancient Stone
truehistory.us.description: Learning about those whose curiosity about the Earth and its fossils leads to the development of the science of paleontology; studying the geographic, climatic and chemical requirements for a living organism to leave behind its fossilized record. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Tools of the Paleontological Trade
truehistory.us.description: In addition to the basic mechanical tools still used in the field today, paleontologists have an exciting digital tool chest; dispersive x-ray spectroscopy and x-ray computer tomography and their use to examine fossils of varying sizes and shapes. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - How Do You Fossilize Behavior?
truehistory.us.description: While the fossilized remains of some organisms are rarely found, the evidence of their existence, as they interacted with the environment, exists; learning how trace fossils help understand the early evolution of the biosphere and animal life. (Science) - 2016-11-11

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Super Sonoran

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S47 E21 Walpole ADU: Welcome to Walpole A Walpole ranch is reimagined with an ADU for aging parents, a primary suite bump-out, smarter baths and better flow from garage to new mudroom and kitchen.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S47 E22 Walpole ADU: An ADU Takes Shape Kevin demos a wall in the primary bedroom; framing an exterior wall to tie old and new spaces together; reviewing shared plumbing for the ADU; burying a new 400-amp service to feed both homes.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E21 Water Heater; Mosquito Trap; Exterior Trim Helping a homeowner replace his old water heater with a heat pump water heater that uses much less electricity; propane-fueled mosquito traps and how to keep them working; Tom helps a homeowner install exterior trim against an uneven stone chimney.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E22 Lawn Repair; Utility Cart; Drain Clog Contractor Roger Cook helps a homeowner revive damaged lawn; general contractor Tom Silva shows Kevin how to build a simple utility cart out of plywood; plumbing and heating expert Richard Trethewey helps a homeowner fix a clogged kitchen sink drain.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E23 String Trimmer; Clamps; Lead Paint Roger shows a homeowner how to use and maintain string trimmers; Tom Silva and Kevin O'Connor discuss different types of woodworking clamps and their uses; Kevin and a remediation team help a homeowner remove dangerous lead paint from her old house.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E24 Bird Feeders; Molding; Dual-Flush Toilet How to attract many different species of birds using different types of birdfeeders and birdseed; various types of interior moldings and their uses; conserving water by installing a new type of dual-flush valve in an existing toilet.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E25 Newel Post; Cutting Pipes; Propagating Plants Tom helps a homeowner repair a wobbly newel post at the bottom of a staircase; Richard shows Kevin several methods for cutting rigid pipes and flexible tubing; Roger visits an expert to learn how to reproduce plants from cuttings and by grafting.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E26 Outdoor Faucet; Mower Blades; Closet Shelving Plumbing and heating expert Richard Trethewey helps a homeowner replace his leaky outdoor faucet; Roger Cook shows Kevin how to sharpen a lawn mower blade properly; What Is It?; Tom and Kevin build custom shelving for a walk-in closet.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S09 E05 Accessible Garden Bed; Roof Vent Repair Landscaping contractor Roger Cook builds a raised garden bed that is accessible by wheelchair; general contractor Tom Silva shows a homeowner how to repair a leak in his roof caused by a worn-out plumbing vent gasket.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S09 E06 Groundcover; Baseboard Heat; Electrical Box Different types of ground cover; helping a homeowner warm up her cold living room by installing new hydronic baseboard heaters; a new product that makes it easier to mark and cut openings for electrical outlets in wallboard.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S09 E07 Circular Patio; Repointing Brick Steps Landscaping contractor Roger Cook heads to Fargo, North Dakota, where he and a local crew help a homeowner build a new circular patio and fire pit; Tom and Kevin head outside to repair a set of brick stairs.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

waypointtv.us.description: S01 E01 Kyle Green and his buddy Jeremy set out on a buffalo hunt; along the way they learn about the true past and future of the American buffalo from interesting people with different perspectives.

waypointtv.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors : The Invasive Carp Disaster
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E02 Kyle Green heads to Yankton, S.D., to learn about the history of the Missouri River and the people who count on the river for sustenance.

waypointtv.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors : The Great Eastern Turkey
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E03 Kyle Green meets up with his friends at the National Wild Turkey Federation to dive into turkey conservation and hunt the largest subspecies of wild turkey.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Double Drop Tines in the House -- First Georgia Cold Front
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E19 The first cool snap rolls into Georgia over the weekend, and the crew heads out to the woods in full force; a few does hit the dirt; Tyler Jordan misses a double drop tine giant that shows up 40 minutes after he climbs out of his treestand.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : 15 Yard Bow Kill - Pitts on the Board With a Giant Nine
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E20 Michael Pitts ends a two-year quest for a giant deer, which also happens to be a bow buck, in Harris County, Ga.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : 165 Giant Buck With a Bow
waypointtv.us.description: Realtree's Ben McDonald gets lucky again on his first sit in Nebraska; this time he rattles in an absolute big whitetail into Bow Range.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Georgia 10 POINTER Hits The Dirt- Pre Rut Deer Hunting
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E21 The Road Trips crew is out hunting from Iowa down to Georgia where the guys are joined by Joel Burham of Whitetail Fit and Josh Sparks of MidWest Whitetail. The pre-rut action is getting hot, and Charlie Thomas puts down his hit-list 10-pointer.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : RATTLING in GIANT BUCK - Nebraska Pre Rut
waypointtv.us.description: Ben McDonald heads back to Nebraska this time to freezing temp and snow. Ben is after a huge bodied buck that has started to show up on trail cameras. He is hoping the first time into the area is the charm as he bow hunts this Nebraska Giant Buck!

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : The Riley Green Show
waypointtv.us.description: S19 E10 Following Tyler Jordan and friends as they take a road trip around the country hunting deer, turkey and ducks!

classica.us.title: Mahler - 2. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Das Lucerne Festival Orchestra, das 2003 gegründet wurde, präsentiert eine fantastische Interpretation von Gustav Mahlers "Auferstehung" unter der Leitung von Dirigent Claudio Abbado. Die Solistinnen werden vom "Orfeón Donostiarra"-Chor begleitet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-02-27

classica.us.title: Mahler - 9. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Das Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester wurde im Jahr 1986 gegründet. Heute zählt es zu den besten Jugendorchestern weltweit. Es wurde auf Claudio Abbados Initiative gegründet. Das Repertoire des Orchesters ist stark vom Werk Gustav Mahlers geprägt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-04-09

classica.us.title: Divas and Diamonds
classica.us.description: Der Film unternimmt eine Zeitreise in die Ära der Schwarz-Weiß-Filme, als Stars wie Marilyn Monroe, Judy Garland und Audrey Hepburn die Zuschauer in Filmen mit ihren unvergesslichen Stimmen und ihrer Ausdruckskraft verzauberten. (Special, Music, Concert) - 2020-01-01

classica.us.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26
classica.us.description: Die Sendung zeigt eine Aufführung von Schumanns "Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26". (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2023-12-12

classica.us.title: Holst - Die Planeten
classica.us.description: Conrad van Alphen dirigiert die Sinfonia Rotterdam und den Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in einer Aufführung von Gustav Holsts The Planets, Op. 32, aufgenommen in De Doelen, Rotterdam, im Jahr 2019. Van Alphen gründete Sinfonia Rotterdam im Jahr 2000. (Special, Performing arts) - 2007-04-26

classica.us.title: Sinfonie Nr. 3, in D-Moll
classica.us.description: Gustav Mahlers Dritte Symphonie, komponiert zwischen 1895 und 1896, ist ein monumentales, programmatisches Werk, das Themen wie Natur, Menschheit und spirituelle Erhebung erforscht. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2026-02-14

classica.us.title: Bach - 6. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Václav Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 6 in B-Dur, BWV 1051. Im Gegensatz zu den anderen Konzerten gibt es in diesem Stück keine Geigen. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-18

classica.us.title: Verdi - Rigoletto
classica.us.description: Riccardo Frizza dirigiert das Orchester und den Chor des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einer Aufführung der tragischen Oper Rigoletto von Giuseppe Verdi. Im Jahr 1850 erhielt Verdi vom Teatro La Fenice den Auftrag, eine neue Oper zu komponieren. Verdi schlug seinem Librettisten Francesco Maria Piave das kontroverse Stück Le Roi s'amuse von Victor Hugo vor. Diese Aufführung wurde 2021 im Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florenz aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-11-15

classica.us.title: Prokofjew - Peter und der Wolf
classica.us.description: Das weltberühmte sinfonische Märchen von Sergej Prokofjew wird in einer neuen Interpretation präsentiert. Der Dirigent erzählt die Geschichte auf seine Art und wird dabei vom Britten-Pears Orchester musikalisch unterstützt. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2019-11-16

classica.us.title: Brahms - Klarinettensonate Nr. 2, Op. 120
classica.us.description: Die 1984 geschriebenen Klarinettensonaten op. 120 sind die letzten Kammermusikstücke, die Johannes Brahms vor seinem Tod komponiert hat. (Special) - 2026-07-14

classica.us.title: J. S. Bach - Weihnachtsoratorium, BWV 248
classica.us.description: Der Thomanerchor Leipzig und das Gewandhausorchester interpretieren Bachs Weihnachtsoratorium. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2019-10-18

classica.us.title: Antonio Manna: Il basso napolitano
classica.us.description: Stefano Demicheli dirigiert das Ensemble Talenti Vulcanici und die Solisten Nicola Cianncio und Catherine Jones in einem abwechslungsreichen Programm aus Barockmusik, aufgenommen in der Chiesa di Santa Caterina da Siena in Neapel, Italien. (Special, Music) - 2021-07-13

classica.us.title: Misha Enzovoort
classica.us.description: Für Misha Mengelberg hat das Vergessen begonnen. Er wartet auf ein Taxi, das er nicht gerufen hat, um zu einem Konzert zu fahren, das nicht stattfindet. Der niederländische Komponist, Pianist und Meister des Jazz Misha Mengelberg, geboren 1935, taucht immer tiefer in das Dunkel der Demenz, die sein Musikerleben beendet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2017-05-19

classica.us.title: Heyward dirigiert Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 9
classica.us.description: Es ist eins der beliebtesten Stücke aller Zeiten: Mit der Aufführung von der 9. Sinfonie e-Moll unter dem Namen "Aus der Neuen Welt" von Antonín Dvořáks gibt der amerikanische Dirigent Jonathon Heyward mit dem "London Symphony Orchestra" sein Debüt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-10-04

classica.us.title: Schostakowitsch - Concertino für zwei Klaviere
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich dem Repertoire für Klavier und Violine in diesem wunderbaren Konzert, das im Château de Chantilly in Frankreich aufgezeichnet wurde. (Special, Music) - 2025-05-31

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Danielpour - Elegies
classica.us.description: Hartmut Haenchen leitet das Orchester der Philharmonie zuidnederland in einem Konzert von Richard Danielpours "Elegies". Solisten sind Marina Prudenskaya und Thomas Oliemans. Die Aufnahme entstand 2019 im Muziekgebouw Eindhoven in den Niederlanden. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-04-04

classica.us.title: Mozart - Sinfonie Nr. 34, K. 338
classica.us.description: Der Maestro Iván Fischer dirigiert das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einem fesselnden Konzertprogramm mit Werken von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart und Antonín Dvořák. Eröffnet wird das Programm mit Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 in C-Dur. (Special, Event) - 2025-06-04

classica.us.title: House of Dreams
classica.us.description: Ein fantasievolles Konzert führt mit barocker Musik auf eine magische, musikalische Reise. Das Ensemble des Tafelmusik Barock Orchester hat sich auf historische Performances spezialisiert. Ihre Musik trifft auf barocke Kunst. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2019-11-08

classica.us.title: Liszt - Zwei sinfonische Dichtungen
classica.us.description: Franz Liszt verfasste 13 sinfonische Dichtungen, die von literarischen Texten inspiriert waren. Der Komponist schrieb Klavier-Duette für diese Dichtungen, die sein beeindruckendes Talent zeigten, ein volles Orchester mit nur einem Piano zu imitieren. (Special, Music) - 2025-08-15

classica.us.title: Ginandrea Noseda
classica.us.description: Dieser Dokumentarfilm berichtet über den italienischen Dirigenten Gianandrea Noseda. (Special, Music, Documentary) - 2017-08-24

classica.us.title: Schumann - Sinfonische Etüden, op. 13
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwarz Schumanns Symphonische Etüden op. 13. Das zwischen 1834 und 1837 komponierte Werk bestand zunächst aus einem Thema und einer Reihe von sechzehn Variationen. Es wurde von Baron von Fricken komponiert. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-01-16

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Mariss Jansons
classica.us.description: Mariss Jansons probt mit dem Oslo Philharmonischen Orchester die kraftvolle Suite aus Béla Bartóks Pantomimenballett "Der wunderbare Mandarin", gefolgt von einer Aufführung des gleichen Stücks aus dem Konzerthaus von Oslo. (Music) - 2000-04-23

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise für zwei Klaviere Op. 77
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags spielt Martha Argerich Saint-Saëns Polonaise für Klavier Op. 77. Das Konzert wurde im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich, aufgezeichnet. Die Pianistin wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet. (Special, Music) - 2025-06-01

classica.us.title: Tschaikowski - Violinkonzert, op. 35
classica.us.description: Simone Lamsma spielt mit dem London Symphony Orchestra unter der Leitung von Gianandrea Noseda Pjotr Tschaikowskis Violinkonzert in D-Dur. Bei diesem Konzert aus der Londoner Barbican Hall entfacht Lamsma ein virtuoses Feuer. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-11-01

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S38 E34 Sterling And Lolo Wood Xxix In an all new episode of Ridiculousness, Rob and Steelo welcome Lolo Wood to check out some IGUANA DRAMA and brace themselves for KID COLLISIONS.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S40 E2 Sterling and Lolo Wood XXXVI On this episode of Ridiculousness Rob, Steelo, and Lolo Wood learn about high speed presents with DRIVE-BY GIFTS, run up against a wall with RUN-BLOCKS and take on some mom insults with CRITICAL MOMS.

10shakeperth.au.title: Gold Wars Downunder
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Donnie begs for a job. Kimberley complains about the living conditions at 1870. And Damo locks in his $500,000 target.

10shakeperth.au.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E17 Newtralized! Raph is worried about Casey's ability to handle big mutant threats...when they meet Slash again and discover he has a partner of his own THE NEWTRALIZER!

10shakeperth.au.title: Danny Phantom
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E1 Eye For An Eye Danny & Vlad's game of revenge starts off childish, but ends when Vlad runs for mayor of Amity Park and wins. Now Danny must survive the gruelling rules the billionaire-turned-politician has placed.

10shakeperth.au.title: Invader Zim
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E7 Planet Jackers / Rise Of The Zitboy ZIM must rescue Earth from Planet Jackers and make it, once again, safe for Irken invasion. / ZIM disguises his pimple as his friend Pustulio, who ends up having hypnotic powers.

10shakeperth.au.title: Hey Arnold!
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E10 Monkey Business / Big Caesar After being scratched by an organ grinder's monkey, Helga is convinced her days are numbered. // Arnold and Gerald attempt to catch the biggest fish in the city pond.

10shakeperth.au.title: T.U.F.F Puppy
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E18 True Spies / Bagel And The Beast Kitty and Dudley accidentally drink Keswick's truth syrup and can't stop telling the truth! // Petropolis is convinced that Bigfoot is a burglar, so Dudley sets out to clear his childhood hero's name.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S9 E24 Food Con Castaways / Snail Mail The gang heads to a food convention, but things go awry when they become stranded in the woods. SpongeBob lies to his pen pal, but when his friend comes to visit, he must keep the ruse going!

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E18 Sir Nonny The Nice Nonny is on a quest to become a real knight! He has a shield. He has a suit of armour. But does he have what it takes to win a knightly game of mini-golf?

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E15 Bubble Duckies! Welcome to the Wings Over Bubbletucky Air Show! Today the Bubble Guppies are watching a whole bunch of birds take flight!

10shakeperth.au.title: Mr. Crocodile
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E11 Cluc Croc / One Tree Home Mr. Crocodile joins gymnastics club because Daisy loves it. // Mr. Crocodile and Daisy help Gigi and Roland find separate homes when they don't want to share a tree anymore.

10shakeperth.au.title: Garden Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E12 Triangle & Yellow Gardener Tim shares a special lesson with Margarita and Col. They learn about triangles objects and the colour yellow through known objects.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E10 Toucan Do It! Blaze, Starla and Darington want to play jungle ball. But when their teammate Tooks the Toucan gets launched from the stadium, it's up to the friends to get her back in the game.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E11 Falcon Quest High above Animal Island, a remarkable race is about to begin. Challenged by a tough-talking falcon, Blaze takes off on a journey to earn his place with the fast fliers in the sky above Animal Island.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E23 Pups Save A Frozen Camp Out / Pups Save The Fizzy Pickles Cap'n Turbot brings the Porters to Sunny Slope Island for a camp-out, but the next day, snow falls on to the island. An over-pressurized pickle jar pops and knocks Cap'n Turbot's.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E24 Pups Save A Pluck-O-Matic / Pups Save A Mascot Rocky must shut down the farm's out-of-control corn harvester machine. The Adventure Bay cheer team, led by Mayor Goodway and Francois, is joined by the newcomer, Danny, but he is taken away by eagles.

10shakeperth.au.title: DORA
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E8 Adventures In Plantsitting / Andrea The Alebrije Dora and Boots take care of baby flowers so Isa can attend a royal tea party. / Dora and Boots help baby Andrea find the magical leaf so she can receive her Alebrije powers.

10shakeperth.au.title: Baby Shark's Big Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E13 Daddy's Favorite / The Goldie Standard The Sharks compete in a gameshow to devide which of them is Daddy's favourite. / Goldie attempts to win over a fishy who isn't her biggest fan.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E12 The Big Ant-Venture Blaze and Zeg discover a world of tiny creatures right under their tyres: Insect City! The friends transform into a super-strong ant and a bouncy grasshopper for their littlest big adventure yet!

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E13 Ready, Set, Roar! Blaze and Stripes transform into ferociously fast jungle cats to race in the Animal Island Championship! But they must beat Crusher disguised as a cheating cheetah. Can they claw their way to victory?

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S8 E26 Pups Stop A Big Leak/pups Save A Baby Anteater/pups Save A Hatch Day/pups Save The Munchie Mobile Pups rescue Francois from a geyser/ Pups rescue a baby anteater stuck on a bucking RoboHorse/ Pups rescue Ace & her special delivery for Chickaletta's party/ Pups rescue Mr. Porter and his food truck.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S9 E1 Liberty Makes A New Friend / Pups Save The Pup Pup Boogie Contest Liberty mistakenly brings a bear into town, thinking it's someone's pet. // Francois' hot-air balloon goes out of control before the Pup Pup Boogie Contest. The Pups, with Liberty, race to the rescue.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tim Rex in Space
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E6 Roadtrip / Tickets / Talent Show The Rex family go on a road trip through the galaxy to get to Rocket World /Tim & Kai compete to get Terri's spare Space-Land ticket /Tim, Tia & Tommy decide to put on a talent show.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble & Crew
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E1 The Crew Builds A Halloween Maze / The Crew Builds A Giant Pup House Rubble & Crew build a spooky Halloween maze, but Omar and Romar get lost inside! / A scary movie keeps Rubble up, so the pups build a fix so everyone can sleep.

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E15 Triple-Track Train Race! Choo choo! An old-fashioned steam locomotive is competing in the Triple-Track Train Race! But when a herd of cows wanders onto the tracks, the Bubble Guppies better think fast before it's too late!

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E16 Only The Sphinx Nose! Join the Bubble Guppies on an adventure to ancient Egypt, as they follow clues across the desert, along the river Nile, and through a pyramid to sniff out the Sphinx's missing nose!

10shakeperth.au.title: Gabby's Dollhouse

abcentertains.au.title: ER - Let The Games Begin
abcentertains.au.description: While undergoing treatment for HIV, Jeanie gets dismissed from a bloody trauma by Benton. Greene and Lewis' mutual attraction increases. County General gets a new Chief of Staff, Dr. Donald Anspaugh. (Drama)

abcentertains.au.title: Not Going Out - Escape Room
abcentertains.au.description: As a surprise for Lee's birthday, Lucy invites the family to join them in an escape room. The event proves hard to forget, with Lee handcuffed to a bomb, a 'traitor' in the room, and Toby's work life called into question. (Comedy)

abcentertains.au.title: rage Charts
abcentertains.au.description: Count down the hottest chart hits and catch up on some of the most promising new popular music videos on rage. (Music)

abcentertains.au.title: Spooks
abcentertains.au.description: MI5 is asked to intervene when the latest round of Middle East peace talks is abruptly halted after a key delegate disappears. (Drama)

abcentertains.au.title: Portrait Artist Of The Year - Chris Packham, Arlene Phillips, Ali Jawad
abcentertains.au.description: In this seventh heat, nine artists are challenged to create a portrait of one of three celebrities: nature presenter and campaigner Chris Packham, choreographer Arlene Phillips and champion power lifter Ali Jawad. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Penn & Teller: Fool Us - The Eight Stooges
abcentertains.au.description: Featured magicians include Jack Kelly, Mortenn Christiansen, Robin Sheikh and Magic Samk. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Guy Montgomery's Guy Mont Spelling Bee (NZ) - You Lost Me At
abcentertains.au.description: Ben Hurley, Rhiannon McCall, Jacquie Brown and our reigning champ from episode four try to take each other down with their varied spelling knowledge. Guy throws at them games like: Flags, A Decent Proposal and Social Media. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: QI - Horrible
abcentertains.au.description: This episode of QI is a wholesale homage to all that is 'horrible'. Joining QI Master Stephen Fry are panellists Alan Davies, Dara O'Briain, Sean Lock and Chris Addison. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Adventure Time - The Eyes
abcentertains.au.description: An exhausted Finn and Jake are creeped out by an odd-looking horse that mysteriously appears outside the treehouse and keeps them awake. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: We Baby Bears - Fiesta Day
abcentertains.au.description: The Bears party it up with a living pinatas for Fiesta Day. Wanting the festivities to never end, Grizz wishes for it to be Fiesta Day everyday. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Teen Titans Go! - Don't Be an Icarus
abcentertains.au.description: Robin tries to tell some Greek myths, but the other Titans give their own fractured versions instead. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls - Derby Dollies
abcentertains.au.description: When Bubbles joins the Derbytantes, Buttercup finds herself on the sidelines. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir - Frightningale
abcentertains.au.description: A young American singer gets akumatized into Frightningale. Armed with a magic mike, she wants to turn Paris into a giant musical. Ladybug and Cat Noir will have to keep the rhythm if they want to stop her! (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Malory Towers - The Chamber
abcentertains.au.description: The pressure is on for Gwen when Felicity suddenly gets stage fright! Meanwhile, Ruth and Susan's hard work comes to fruition when they make an amazing discovery before Mr Murray reveals his true colours. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Odd Squad - Extreme Cake-over
abcentertains.au.description: Otis and Olympia accidently release a virus that turns agents into cakes. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: We Bare Bears - Beehive
abcentertains.au.description: The Bears allow bees to live in the cave to make honey. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Little Lunch - The Band
abcentertains.au.description: Bored during a rainy little lunch, Atticus starts a band and makes Battie reluctantly join too.

abcentertains.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire - Brave the Wave
abcentertains.au.description: Ash challenges the Dewford Gym, but Gym Leader Brawly seems more interested in surfing! (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Transformers: Earthspark - Disarmed
abcentertains.au.description: Robby, Mo, and the Terrans attempt to unlock new cyber-sleeve powers, with disastrous results. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Adventure Time - In Your Footsteps
abcentertains.au.description: A bear befriends Finn and Jake, but what are his true intentions? (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Teen Titans Go! - The Cape
abcentertains.au.description: The Titans reminisce about when they threw a party for Cinderblock. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Teen Titans Go! - Classic Titans
abcentertains.au.description: Control Freak sends the Titans to a former version of the team. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Stars
abcentertains.au.description: When Dad gives Larry's hairdresser a bad review for saying he's bald, he gets offered a free haircut. This inspires Gumball and Darwin to go on a reviewing spree across town. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Super Happy Magic Forest - Faking It
abcentertains.au.description: It's been ages since their last quest and the heroes are losing their edge, so Friendlyface sends the heroes on a fake quest to get rid of a monster. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Submarine Jim - Submarine Jim, Part 1
abcentertains.au.description: The sub is stolen by pirates after they set a trap. Unable to find a solution, Jim accepts Cyril's proposal: to defrost Roy using an extraordinary human invention. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Total Dramarama - Ant We All Just Get Along
abcentertains.au.description: Owen and Beth try to save an ant hill that Courtney and Leshawna want to destroy. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir - Wishmaker
abcentertains.au.description: As Marinette thinks about her future, a supervillain shows up in Paris. Able to force people to live their childhood dreams, he turns into a nightmare for our heroes. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Ninjago - The Forgotten Element
abcentertains.au.description: After stealing the remaining contestant's powers, Chen only needs Lloyd's power to complete the spell and knowing his daughter has feelings for Kai, Chen tries to enlist the Fire Ninja by promising to share secrets. (Kids & Family)

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: A Girl's Guide to Hunting, Fishing and Wild Cooking
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E3 Episode 3 Analiese embarks on new adventures, raising two piglets for meat with her neighbour, confronting her fear of bees for a wild honey harvest, and goes on a solo fly-fishing trip for wild trout.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Paddock To Plate
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E7 Perth And Margaret River, WA With its sun, surf and warm climate, the South West coast is suited to growing a diverse range of produce. Matt samples Australia's best veal, makes halloumi and discovers biodynamic vegies.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E7 Puebla, Where The Cooks Are From According to Tony, the best line cooks in N.Y.C. come from Mexico, so he travels to Puebla, and enjoys mole sauces, toasted ant eggs, fried worms, and the legendary pulque.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E8 The Cook Who Came In From The Cold Tony plays spy in Russia and sets off to locate the best blinis and borscht St. Petersburg has to offer.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S8 E81 Tastes Like Happiness Adam, award-winning food historian Dr. Lauren Samuelsson and the founder of London's iconic ice cream shop Happy Endings, Terri Mercieca, share a few recipes that taste like happiness.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S6 E1 Lacko & Kinnekulle: A Historical Food Adventure Tareq Taylor, one of Sweden's most loved chefs, visits Nordic countries to collect the very best culinary experiences.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Jamie At Home
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E12 Rhubarb Rhubarb is finally having a resurgence! This is good news for the UK as historically they grow some of the best rhubarb in the world.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Cheese Slices
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E3 Roquefort With a fascinating history that dates back to Roman times, the importance of Roquefort cheese cannot be underestimated. Will visits a typical dairy to look at a unique breed of milking ewes.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: What Chefs Want
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E5 The Art And Storytelling Of Food Enter the mesmerizing world of food art, where masterpieces are created with equal parts skill and creativity. Chef Janice Wong takes Sally on a chocolate-making journey that culinary art.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E4 Dolceacqua Set between mountains and river, Dolceacqua reveals an unexpected wealth of traditions, character and heritage.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E9 Nuts And Pulses Sophie visits an almond farmer to discover how they are harvested and shelled. A local baker demonstrates how she makes the almond and cherry jam sweet treats that are served all over town.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S3 E1 Patty Mamid: Creamy Chilli Squid & Soybean Seafood Soup Patty Mamid shows us how to prepare creamy chilli squid and soybean seafood soup. Drawing on her multicultural heritage, Patty cooks up two dishes of her own making.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E10 Easter In Cooking It's Easter and Simon surprises Maggie with a chilli Easter Egg whipped up at work under the expert eyes of his pastry chefs. Maggie's no fan of chilli but Simon's determined to win her over.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: My Market Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S8 E24 Episode 24 Luke Hines shows Laura his 5-ingredient Garlicky Hash Browns in the Prahran Market.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E24 Roast Sausage And Celery Root Flan Rachael and her sister Maria are teaming up to demonstrate how to make a rustic meal of roasted pork and chicken sausages tossed with vegetables and grapes.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn Bbq
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E1 Manly Beach After a morning surf, Hayden demonstrates the best ways to BBQ over coals, and showcases dishes featuring salmon fillet, chicken thigh, and beef rump steak.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S6 E2 Julia Louis-Dreyfus The incredible 11 time Emmy award-winning actor, comedian, writer and producer Julia Louis Dreyfus is joining Ina at the barn.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: My Market Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S9 E19 Episode 19 Laura is in a French mood and makes crepes to share with the market workers. Catherine Velisha makes a late-night burger into a healthy meal with a burger that she calls the Naked Hawaiian.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Taste Of Australia In Vietnam
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E2 Ho Chi Minh City And Dalat Travelling to mountainous Da Lat and bustling Ho Chi Minh City, Luke enthuses about the street food, learns about a ground-breaking approach to farming and meets with artistic Australians.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S8 E81 Tastes Like Happiness Adam, award-winning food historian Dr. Lauren Samuelsson and the founder of London's iconic ice cream shop Happy Endings, Terri Mercieca, share a few recipes that taste like happiness.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Jamie At Home
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E13 Winter Salads Jamie is nearly knocked off his feet in this episode as he braves the gales to collect a variety of salad.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S8 E20 The Italian Products Have Arrived! The arrival of Italians into America demanded the need for Italian products as well. This resulted in more creativity and flavour in the kitchen like Belgian and red endive salads and cherry jam tarts.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Cheese Slices
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E4 Spain Will travels to the land of Don Quixote to look at Manchego cheese before heading for the annual cheese fair at the medieval city of Trujillo and looking at cheese made from Merino ewes milk.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: What Chefs Want
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E6 Sustainability Sustainability meets gastronomy, where Chef Matteo Ponti shares his passion for eco-friendly cooking. Sally discovers city farming at the Arden Food Forest, and explores the sustainable fish farming.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E5 Bordighera One of the Riviera's most iconic seaside resorts, Bordighera captivates with its timeless charm.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E10 The Importance Of Cheese Sophie visits a local cheese maker to see how they age their cheeses in caves and stuffs courgette flowers with local ricotta. She is also shown how to make the cakes known locally as nun's breasts.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S3 E2 Neville Poelina: Orange Duck & Curry Bush Turkey Neville Poelina will show us how to make two delicious dishes with duck and bush turkey - making the most out of his outdoor forty-four gallon homemade bush oven.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E11 Cooking With Kids School Holidays mean finding things for the kids to do and Maggie and Simon get some kids busy looking for mushrooms and picking plums. Simon also visits a Mussel farm in Port Lincoln.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: My Market Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S8 E25 Episode 25 Laura is joined by nutritionist Cassie Lawless to make delicious and healthy Thai Coconut Chicken Meatballs in the beautiful McLaren Vale region of South Australia.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E25 Getting Figgy With It: Chicken And Fig Rachael is joined by her husband, John, and her sister, Maria, as she shows how to prepare a Chicken and Fig dish featured on their wedding menu.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn Bbq
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E2 Manly Dam Manly Dam is one of Hayden's favourite spots for a BBQ, and Hayden cooks up a storm with dishes featuring chicken drumsticks, wood-roasted salmon, and leg of lamb.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S6 E3 Stephen Colbert And Evie McGee-Colbert The amazing talk show host, comedian, writer and producer Stephen Colbert and his wife, Producer Evie McGee Colbert are joining Ina for a wonderful day at the barn.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: My Market Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S9 E20 Episode 20 Laura has an early start in the market as she makes her cheesy Chorizo Lasagne, before she assembles the go-to dish when you need to clean out your fridge, her delicious Frittata.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Taste Of Australia In Vietnam
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E3 Con Dao, Phu Quoc And Bac Lieu Luke gets up early on two of Vietnam's southern islands to learn about sea turtle conservation and join the local fishermen. In the Mekong Delta he visits a Vietnamese-Australian-run shrimp business.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S9 E49 Episode 49 A guest vegan dessert, a twist on salad and a trip to Macao. This episode of Everyday Gourmet gives you a whole lot of foodie variety.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S8 E82 Tomato Party You say tomato, Adam says tomato party. On the guest list: chef Shane Delia, Paralympic gold and silver medallist Vanessa Low OAM, and you!

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Beyond Bali With Lara Lee
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E8 West Timor: New Connections And Family Ties In West Timor, Lara is reunited with her father's birthplace, meeting extended family, learning home-cooked recipes and deepening her connection to her Indonesian heritage.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: How Do They Really Do It?
